Vayyomer malach Adonai el-manoach im-tatzereni lo-ochal belachmecha veim-taase ola la-Adonai taalenna ki lo-yada manoach ki-malach Adonai hu
Vayyomer manoach el-malach Adonai mi shemecha ki-yavo devarcha vechibbadnucha
Vayyomer lo malach Adonai lamma ze tishal lishmi vehu-feliy
Vayyikkach manoach et-gedi haizzim veet-hammincha vayyaal al-hatztzur la-Adonai umafli laasot umanoach veishto roim
Vayehi vaalot hallahav meal hammizbeach hashshamayema vayyaal malach-Adonai belahav hammizbeach umanoach veishto roim vayyippelu al-penehem artza
Velo-yasaf od malach Adonai leherao el-manoach veel-ishto az yada manoach ki-malach Adonai hu
Vayyomer manoach el-ishto mot namut ki elohim rainu
Vattomer lo ishto lu chafetz Adonai lahamitenu lo-lakach miyyadenu ola umincha velo heranu et-kal-elle vechaet lo hishmianu kazot
Vatteled haishsha ben vattikra et-shemo shimshon vayyigdal hannaar vayevarchehu Adonai
Vattachel ruach Adonai lefaamo bemachane-dan ben tzara uven eshtaol
Vayyered shimshon timnata vayyar ishsha betimnata mibbenot pelishtim
Vayyaal vayyagged leaviv ulimmo vayyomer ishsha raiti vetimnata mibbenot pelishtim veatta kechu-otah li leishsha
Vayyomer lo aviv veimmo haen bivnot achecha uvchal-ammi ishsha ki-atta holech lakachat ishsha mippelishtim haarelim vayyomer shimshon el-aviv otah kach-li ki-hi yashra veena
Veaviv veimmo lo yadu ki me-Adonai hi ki-toana hu-mevakkesh mippelishtim uvaet hahi pelishtim moshlim beyisrael
Vayyered shimshon veaviv veimmo timnata vayyavou ad-karme timnata vehinne kefir araot shoeg likrato
Vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vayeshasseehu keshassa haggedi umuma en beyado velo higgid leaviv ulimmo et asher asa
Vayyered vayedabber laishsha vattishar beene shimshon
Vayyashav miyyamim lekachtah vayyasar lirot et mappelet haarye vehinne adat devorim bigviyyat haarye udvash
Vayyirdehu el-kappav vayyelech haloch veachol vayyelech el-aviv veel-immo vayyitten lahem vayyochelu velo-higgid lahem ki miggeviyyat haarye rada haddevash
Vayyered avihu el-haishsha vayyaas sham shimshon mishte ki ken yaasu habbachurim
Vayehi kirotam oto vayyikchu sheloshim mereim vayyihyu itto
Vayyomer lahem shimshon achuda-na lachem chida im-hagged taggidu otah li shivat yeme hammishte umtzatem venatatti lachem sheloshim sedinim ushloshim chalifot begadim
Veim-lo tuchlu lehaggid li untattem attem li sheloshim sedinim ushloshim chalifot begadim vayyomru lo chuda chidatcha venishmaenna
Vayyomer lahem mehaochel yatza maachal umeaz yatza matok velo yachlu lehaggid hachida sheloshet yamim
Vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyomru leeshet-shimshon patti et-ishech veyagged-lanu et-hachida pen-nisrof otach veet-bet avich baesh halyarshenu keratem lanu halo
Vattevke eshet shimshon alav vattomer rak-senetani velo ahavtani hachida chadta livne ammi veli lo higgadta vayyomer lah hinne leavi ulimmi lo higgadti velach aggid
Vattevke alav shivat hayyamim asher-haya lahem hammishte vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyagged-lah ki hetzikathu vattagged hachida livne ammah
Vayyomru lo anshe hair bayyom hashshevii beterem yavo hacharsa ma-matok middevash ume az meari vayyomer lahem lule charashtem beeglati lo metzatem chidati
Vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vayyered ashkelon vayyach mehem sheloshim ish vayyikkach et-chalitzotam vayyitten hachalifot lemaggide hachida vayyichar appo vayyaal bet avihu
Vattehi eshet shimshon lemereehu asher rea lo
Vayehi miyyamim bime ketzir-chittim vayyifkod shimshon et-ishto bigdi izzim vayyomer avoa el-ishti hechadra velo-netano aviha lavo
Vayyomer aviha amor amarti ki-sano senetah vaettenenna lemereecha halo achotah hakketanna tova mimmenna tehi-na lecha tachteha
Vayyomer lahem shimshon nikketi happaam mippelishtim ki-ose ani immam raa
Vayyelech shimshon vayyilkod shelosh-meot shualim vayyikkach lappidim vayyefen zanav el-zanav vayyasem lappid echad ben-shene hazzenavot battavech
Vayyaver-esh ballappidim vayeshallach bekamot pelishtim vayyaver miggadish vead-kama vead-kerem zayit
Vayyomru felishtim mi asa zot vayyomru shimshon chatan hattimni ki lakach et-ishto vayyittenah lemereehu vayyaalu felishtim vayyisrefu otah veet-aviha baesh
Vayyomer lahem shimshon im-taasun kazot ki im-nikkamti vachem veachar echdal
Vayyach otam shok al-yarech makka gedola vayyered vayyeshev bisif sela etam
Vayyaalu felishtim vayyachanu bihuda vayyinnatshu ballechi
Vayyomru ish yehuda lama alitem alenu vayyomru leesor et-shimshon alinu laasot lo kaasher asa lanu
Vayyerdu sheloshet alafim ish mihuda el-seif sela etam vayyomru leshimshon halo yadata ki-moshlim banu pelishtim uma-zot asita lanu vayyomer lahem kaasher asu li ken asiti lahem
Vayyomru lo leesarcha yaradnu letittecha beyad-pelishtim vayyomer lahem shimshon hishshavu li pen-tifgeun bi attem
Vayyomru lo lemor lo ki-asor neesarcha untannucha veyadam vehamet lo nemitecha vayyaasruhu bishnayim avotim chadashim vayyaaluhu min-hassala
Hu-va ad-lechi uflishittim heriu likrato vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vattihyena haavotim asher al-zerootav kappishtim asher baaru vaesh vayyimmassu esurav meal yadav
Vayyimtza lechi-chamor teriyya vayyishlach yado vayyikkacheha vayyach-bah elef ish
Vayyomer shimshon bilchi hachamor chamor chamoratayim bilchi hachamor hikketi elef ish
Vayehi kechalloto ledabber vayyashlech hallechi miyyado vayyikra lammakom hahu ramat lechi
Vayyitzma meod vayyikra el-Adonai vayyomar atta natatta veyad-avdecha et-hatteshua haggedola hazzot veatta amut batztzama venafalti beyad haarelim
Vayyivka elohim et-hammachtesh asher-ballechi vayyetzu mimmennu mayim vayyeshte vattashav rucho vayyechi al-ken kara shemah en hakkore asher ballechi ad hayyom hazze
Vayyishpot et-yisrael bime felishtim esrim shana
Vayyelech shimshon azzata vayyar-sham ishsha zona vayyavo eleha
Laazzatim lemor ba shimshon henna vayyasobbu vayyeervu-lo chal-hallayela beshaar hair vayyitcharshu chal-hallayela lemor ad-or habboker vahargenuhu

Vayyishkav shimshon ad-chatzi hallayela vayyakam bachatzi hallayela vayyeechoz bedaltot shaar-hair uvishte hammezuzot vayyissaem im-habberiach vayyasem al-ketefav vayyaalem el-rosh hahar asher al-pene chevron
Vayehi achare-chen vayyeehav ishsha benachal sorek ushmah delila
Vayyaalu eleha sarne felishtim vayyomru lah patti oto uri bamme kocho gadol uvamme nuchal lo vaasarnuhu leannoto vaanachnu nittan-lach ish elef umea kasef
Vattomer delila el-shimshon haggida-na li bamme kochacha gadol uvamme teaser leannotecha
Vayyomer eleha shimshon im-yaasruni beshiva yetarim lachim asher lo-choravu vechaliti vehayiti keachad haadam
Vayyaalu-lah sarne felishtim shiva yetarim lachim asher lo-choravu vattaasrehu bahem
Vehaorev yoshev lah bacheder vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vayenattek et-hayetarim kaasher yinnatek petil-hanneoret baharicho esh velo noda kocho
Vattomer delila el-shimshon hinne hetalta bi vattedabber ela kezavim atta haggida-na li bamme teaser
Vayyomer eleha im-asor yaasruni baavotim chadashim asher lo-naasa vahem melacha vechaliti vehayiti keachad haadam
Vattikkach delila avotim chadashim vattaasrehu vahem vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vehaorev yoshev bechader vayenattekem meal zerootav kachut
Vattomer delila el-shimshon ad-henna hetalta bi vattedabber ela kezavim haggida li bamme teaser vayyomer eleha im-taargi et-sheva machlefot roshi im-hammassachet
Vattitka bayyated vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vayyikatz mishshenato vayyissa et-hayetad haereg veet-hammassachet
Vattomer elav ech tomar ahavtich velibbecha en itti ze shalosh peamim hetalta bi velo-higgadta li bamme kochacha gadol
Vayehi ki-hetzika lo vidvareha kal-hayyamim vattealatzehu vattiktzar nafsho lamut
Vayyagged-lah et-kal-libbo vayyomer lah mora lo-ala al-roshi ki-nezir elohim ani mibbeten immi im-gullachti vesar mimmenni chochi vechaliti vehayiti kechal-haadam
Vattere delila ki-higgid lah et-kal-libbo vattishlach vattikra lesarne felishtim lemor alu happaam ki-higgid li et-kal-libbo vealu eleha sarne felishtim vayyaalu hakkesef beyadam
Vatteyashshenehu al-birkeha vattikra laish vattegallach et-sheva machlefot rosho vattachel leannoto vayyasar kocho mealav
Vattomer pelishtim alecha shimshon vayyikatz mishshenato vayyomer etze kefaam befaam veinnaer vehu lo yada ki Adonai sar mealav
Vayyochazuhu felishtim vayenakkeru et-enav vayyoridu oto azzata vayyaasruhu banchushtayim vayehi tochen bevet haasurim
Vayyachel sear-rosho letzammeach kaasher gullach
Vesarne felishtim neesfu lizboach zevach-gadol ledagon elohehem ulsimcha vayyomru natan elohenu beyadenu et shimshon oyevenu
Vayyiru oto haam vayehallu et-elohehem ki amru natan elohenu veyadenu et-oyevenu veet machariv artzenu vaasher hirba et-chalalenu
Vayehi chy ketov libbam vayyomru kiru leshimshon visachek-lanu vayyikreu leshimshon mibbet haasurim vayetzachek lifnehem vayyaamidu oto ben haammudim
Vayyomer shimshon el-hannaar hammachazik beyado hannicha oti vahamisheni et-haammudim asher habbayit nachon alehem veeshshaen alehem
Vehabbayit male haanashim vehannashim veshamma kol sarne felishtim veal-haggag kishloshet alafim ish veishsha haroim bischok shimshon
Vayyikra shimshon el-Adonai vayyomar adona Adonai zachreni na vechazzekeni na ach happaam hazze haelohim veinnakma nekam-achat mishshete ena mippelishtim
Vayyilpot shimshon et-shene ammude hattavech asher habbayit nachon alehem vayyissamech alehem echad bimino veechad bismolo
Vayyomer shimshon tamot nafshi im-pelishtim vayyet bechoach vayyippol habbayit al-hasseranim veal-kal-haam asher-bo vayyihyu hammetim asher hemit bemoto rabbim measher hemit bechayyav
Vayyerdu echav vechal-bet avihu vayyisu oto vayyaalu vayyikberu oto ben tzara uven eshtaol bekever manoach aviv vehu shafat et-yisrael esrim shana
Vayehi-ish mehar-efrayim ushmo michayehu
Vayyomer leimmo elef umea hakkesef asher lukkach-lach veatte alit vegam amarte beazna hinne-hakkesef itti ani lekachtiv vattomer immo baruch beni la-Adonai
Vayyashev et-elef-umea hakkesef leimmo vattomer immo hakdesh hikdashti et-hakkesef la-Adonai miyyadi livni laasot pesel umassecha veatta ashivennu lach
Vayyashev et-hakkesef leimmo vattikkach immo matayim kesef vattittenehu latztzoref vayyaasehu pesel umassecha vayehi bevet michayehu
Vehaish micha lo bet elohim vayyaas efod utrafim vayemalle et-yad achad mibbanav vayehi-lo lechohen
Bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael ish hayyashar beenav yaase
Vayehi-naar mibbet lechem yehuda mimmishpachat yehuda vehu levi vehu gar-sham
Vayyelech haish mehair mibbet lechem yehuda lagur baasher yimtza vayyavo har-efrayim ad-bet micha laasot darko
Vayyomer-lo micha meayin tavo vayyomer elav levi anochi mibbet lechem yehuda veanochi holech lagur baasher emtza
Vayyomer lo micha sheva immadi vehye-li leav ulchohen veanochi etten-lecha aseret kesef layyamim veerech begadim umichyatecha vayyelech hallevi
Vayyoel hallevi lashevet et-haish vayehi hannaar lo keachad mibbanav
Vayemalle micha et-yad hallevi vayehi-lo hannaar lechohen vayehi bevet micha
Vayyomer micha atta yadati ki-yetiv Adonai li ki haya-li hallevi lechohen
Bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael uvayyamim hahem shevet haddani mevakkesh-lo nachala lashevet ki lo-nafla lo ad-hayyom hahu betoch-shivte yisrael benachala

Vayyishlechu vene-dan mimmishpachtam chamishsha anashim miktzotam anashim bene-chayil mitztzara umeeshtaol leraggel et-haaretz ulchakrah vayyomru alehem lechu chikru et-haaretz vayyavou har-efrayim ad-bet micha vayyalinu sham
Hemma im-bet micha vehemma hikkiru et-kol hannaar hallevi vayyasuru sham vayyomru lo mi-heviacha halom uma-atta ose baze uma-lecha fo
Vayyomer alehem kazo vechaze asa li micha vayyiskereni vaehi-lo lechohen
Vayyomru lo sheal-na velohim veneda hatatzliach darkenu asher anachnu holchim aleha
Vayyomer lahem hakkohen lechu leshalom nochach Adonai darkechem asher telchu-vah

Vayyelchu chameshet haanashim vayyavou layesha vayyiru et-haam asher-bekirbah yoshevet-lavetach kemishpat tzidonim shoket uvoteach veen-machlim davar baaretz yoresh etzer urchokim hemma mitztzidonim vedavar en-lahem im-adam
Vayyavou el-achehem tzara veeshtaol vayyomru lahem achehem ma attem
Vayyomru kuma venaale alehem ki rainu et-haaretz vehinne tova meod veattem machshim al-teatzlu lalechet lavo lareshet et-haaretz
Kevoachem tavou el-am boteach vehaaretz rachavat yadayim ki-netanah elohim beyedchem makom asher en-sham machsor kal-davar asher baaretz
Vayyisu mishsham mimmishpachat haddani mitztzara umeeshtaol shesh-meot ish chagur kele milchama
Vayyaalu vayyachanu bekiryat yearim bihuda al-ken karu lammakom hahu machane-dan ad hayyom hazze hinne achare kiryat yearim
Vayyaavru mishsham har-efrayim vayyavou ad-bet micha
Vayyaanu chameshet haanashim haholchim leraggel et-haaretz layish vayyomru el-achehem hayedatem ki yesh babbattim haelle efod utrafim ufesel umassecha veatta deu ma-taasu
Vayyasuru shamma vayyavou el-bet-hannaar hallevi bet micha vayyishalu-lo leshalom
Veshesh-meot ish chagurim kele milchamtam nitztzavim petach hashshaar asher mibbene-dan

Vayyaalu chameshet haanashim haholchim leraggel et-haaretz bau shamma lakchu et-happesel veet-haefod veet-hatterafim veet-hammassecha vehakkohen nitztzav petach hashshaar veshesh-meot haish hechagur kele hammilchama
Veelle bau bet micha vayyikchu et-pesel haefod veet-hatterafim veet-hammassecha vayyomer alehem hakkohen ma attem osim
Vayyomru lo hacharesh sim-yadcha al-picha velech immanu vehye-lanu leav ulchohen hatov heotcha chohen levet ish echad o heotcha chohen leshevet ulmishpacha beyisrael
Vayyitav lev hakkohen vayyikkach et-haefod veet-hatterafim veet-happasel vayyavo bekerev haam
Vayyifnu vayyelechu vayyasimu et-hattaf veet-hammikne veet-hakkevudda lifnehem
Hemma hirchiku mibbet micha vehaanashim asher babbattim asher im-bet micha nizaku vayyadbiku et-bene-dan
Vayyikreu el-bene-dan vayyassebbu penehem vayyomru lemicha ma-lecha ki nizakta
Vayyomer et-eloha asher-asiti lekachtem veet-hakkohen vattelchu uma-li od uma-ze tomru ela ma-lach
Vayyomru elav bene-dan al-tashma kolcha immanu pen-yifgeu vachem anashim mare nefesh veasafta nafshecha venefesh betecha
Vayyelchu vene-dan ledarkam vayyar micha ki-chazakim hemma mimmennu vayyifen vayyashav el-beto
Vehemma lakchu et asher-asa micha veet-hakkohen asher haya-lo vayyavou al-layish al-am shoket uvoteach vayyakku otam lefi-charev veet-hair sarfu vaesh
Veen matztzil ki rechoka-hi mitztzidon vedavar en-lahem im-adam vehi baemek asher levet-rechov vayyivnu et-hair vayyeshvu vah
Vayyikreu shem-hair dan beshem dan avihem asher yullad leyisrael veulam layish shem-hair larishona
Vayyakimu lahem bene-dan et-happasel vihonatan ben-gershom ben-menashshe hu uvanav hau chohanim leshevet haddani ad-yom gelot haaretz
Vayyasimu lahem et-pesel micha asher asa kal-yeme heot bet-haelohim beshilo
Vayehi bayyamim hahem umelech en beyisrael vayehi ish levi gar beyarkete har-efrayim vayyikkach-lo ishsha filegesh mibbet lechem yehuda
Vattizne alav pilagsho vattelech meitto el-bet aviha el-bet lechem yehuda vattehi-sham yamim arbaa chodashim
Vayyakam ishah vayyelech achareha ledabber al-libbah lahashivah venaaro immo vetzemed chamorim vatteviehu bet aviha vayyirehu avi hannaara vayyismach likrato
Vayyechezak-bo chotno avi hannaara vayyeshev itto sheloshet yamim vayyochlu vayyishtu vayyalinu sham
Vayehi bayyom harvii vayyashkimu vabboker vayyakam lalechet vayyomer avi hannaara el-chatano sead libbecha pat-lechem veachar telechu
Vayyeshvu vayyochlu shenehem yachdav vayyishtu vayyomer avi hannaara el-haish hoel-na velin veyitav libbecha
Vayyakam haish lalechet vayyiftzar-bo chotno vayyashav vayyalen sham
Vayyashkem babboker bayyom hachamishi lalechet vayyomer avi hannaara sead-na levavcha vehitmahmehu ad-netot hayyom vayyochlu shenehem

Vayyakam haish lalechet hu ufilagsho venaaro vayyomer lo chotno avi hannaara hinne na rafa hayyom laarov linu-na hinne chanot hayyom lin po veyitav levavecha vehishkamtem machar ledarkechem vehalachta leohalecha
Velo-ava haish lalun vayyakam vayyelech vayyavo ad-nochach yevus hi yerushalam veimmo tzemed chamorim chavushim ufilagsho immo
Hem im-yevus vehayyom rad meod vayyomer hannaar el-adonav lecha-na venasura el-ir-hayevusi hazzot venalin bah
Vayyomer elav adonav lo nasur el-ir nachri asher lo-mibbene yisrael henna veavarnu ad-giva
Vayyomer lenaaro lecha venikreva beachad hammekomot velannu vaggiva o varama
Vayyaavru vayyelechu vattavo lahem hashshemesh etzel haggiva asher levinyamin
Vayyasuru sham lavo lalun baggiva vayyavo vayyeshev birchov hair veen ish meassef-otam habbayeta lalun
Vehinne ish zaken ba min-maasehu min-hassade baerev vehaish mehar efrayim vehu-gar baggiva veanshe hammakom bene yemini
Vayyissa enav vayyar et-haish haoreach birchov hair vayyomer haish hazzaken ana telech umeayin tavo
Vayyomer elav ovrim anachnu mibbet-lechem yehuda ad-yarkete har-efrayim mishsham anochi vaelech ad-bet lechem yehuda veet-bet Adonai ani holech veen ish meassef oti habbayeta
Vegam-teven gam-mispo yesh lachamorenu vegam lechem vayayin yesh-li velaamatecha velannaar im-avadecha en machsor kal-davar
Vayyomer haish hazzaken shalom lach rak kal-machsorcha ala rak barchov al-talan
Vayeviehu leveto vayyaval lachamorim vayyirchatzu raglehem vayyochlu vayyishtu
Hemma metivim et-libbam vehinne anshe hair anshe vene-veliyyaal nasabbu et-habbayit mitdappekim al-haddalet vayyomru el-haish baal habbayit hazzaken lemor hotze et-haish asher-ba el-betcha venedaennu
Vayyetze alehem haish baal habbayit vayyomer alehem al-acha al-tareu na achare asher-ba haish hazze al-beti al-taasu et-hannevala hazzot
Hinne vitti habbetula ufilagshehu otzia-na otam veannu otam vaasu lahem hattov beenechem velaish hazze lo taasu devar hannevala hazzot
Velo-avu haanashim lishmoa lo vayyachazek haish befilagsho vayyotze alehem hachutz vayyedu otah vayyitallelu-vah kal-hallayela ad-habboker vayeshallechuha kaalot hashshachar
Vattavo haishsha lifnot habboker vattippol petach bet-haish asher-adoneha sham ad-haor
Vayyakam adoneha babboker vayyiftach daltot habbayit vayyetze lalechet ledarko vehinne haishsha filagsho nofelet petach habbayit veyadeha al-hassaf
Vayyomer eleha kumi venelecha veen one vayyikkacheha al-hachamor vayyakam haish vayyelech limkomo
Vayyavo el-beto vayyikkach et-hammaachelet vayyachazek befilagsho vayenattecheha laatzameha lishnem asar netachim vayeshallecheha bechol gevul yisrael
Vehaya chal-haroe veamar lo-nihyeta velo-nirata kazot lemiyyom alot bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ad hayyom hazze simu-lachem aleha utzu vedabberu
Vayyetzu kal-bene yisrael vattikkahel haeda keish echad lemiddan vead-beer sheva veeretz haggilad el-Adonai hammitzpa
Vayyityatztzevu pinnot kal-haam kol shivte yisrael bikhal am haelohim arba meot elef ish ragli sholef charev
Vayyishmeu bene vinyamin ki-alu vene-yisrael hammitzpa vayyomru bene yisrael dabberu echa nihyeta haraa hazzot

Vayyashkimu ashdodim mimmachorat vehinne dagon nofel lefanav artza lifne aron Adonai vayyikchu et-dagon vayyashivu oto limkomo
Vayyashkimu vabboker mimmachorat vehinne dagon nofel lefanav artza lifne aron Adonai verosh dagon ushte kappot yadav kerutot el-hammiftan rak dagon nishar alav
Al-ken lo-yidrechu chohane dagon vechal-habbaim bet-dagon al-miftan dagon beashdod ad hayyom hazze
Vattichbad yad-Adonai el-haashdodim vayeshimmem vayyach otam battechorim et-ashdod veet-gevuleha
Vayyiru anshe-ashdod ki-chen veamru lo-yeshev aron elohe yisrael immanu ki-kashta yado alenu veal dagon elohenu
Vayyishlechu vayyaasfu et-kal-sarne felishtim alehem vayyomru ma-naase laaron elohe yisrael vayyomru gat yissov aron elohe yisrael vayyassebbu et-aron elohe yisrael
Vayehi achare hesabbu oto vattehi yad-Adonai bair mehuma gedola meod vayyach et-anshe hair mikkaton vead-gadol vayyissatru lahem techorim
Vayeshallechu et-aron haelohim ekron vayehi kevo aron haelohim ekron vayyizaku haekronim lemor hesabbu ela et-aron elohe yisrael lahamiteni veet-ammi
Vayyishlechu vayyaasfu et-kal-sarne felishtim vayyomru shallechu et-aron elohe yisrael veyashov limkomo velo-yamit oti veet-ammi ki-hayeta mehumat-mavet bechal-hair kavda meod yad haelohim sham
Vehaanashim asher lo-metu hukku battechorim vattaal shaveat hair hashshamayim
Vayehi aron-Adonai bisde felishtim shiva chodashim
Vayyikreu felishtim lakkohanim velakkosmim lemor ma-naase laaron Adonai hodiunu bamme neshallechennu limkomo
Vayyomru im-meshallechim et-aron elohe yisrael al-teshallechu oto rekam ki-hashev tashivu lo asham az terafu venoda lachem lamma lo-tasur yado mikkem
Vayyomru ma haasham asher nashiv lo vayyomru mispar sarne felishtim chamishsha techore zahav vachamishsha achbere zahav ki-maggefa achat lechullam ulsarnechem
Vaasitem tzalme techorechem vetzalme achberechem hammashchitim et-haaretz untattem lelohe yisrael kavod ula yakel et-yado mealechem umeal elohechem umeal artzechem
Velamma techabbedu et-levavchem kaasher kibbedu mitzrayim ufaro et-libbam halo kaasher hitallel bahem vayeshallechum vayyelechu
Veatta kechu vaasu agala chadasha echat ushte farot alot asher lo-ala alehem ol vaasartem et-happarot baagala vahashevotem benehem meacharehem habbayeta
Ulkachtem et-aron Adonai untattem oto el-haagala veet kele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo veshillachtem oto vehalach
Uritem im-derech gevulo yaale bet shemesh hu asa lanu et-haraa haggedola hazzot veim-lo veyadanu ki lo yado naga banu mikre hu haya lanu
Vayyaasu haanashim ken vayyikchu shette farot alot vayyaasrum baagala veet-benehem kalu vabbayit
Vayyasimu et-aron Adonai el-haagala veet haargaz veet achbere hazzahav veet tzalme techorehem
Vayishsharna happarot badderech al-derech bet shemesh bimsilla achat halchu haloch vegao velo-saru yamin usmol vesarne felishtim holchim acharehem ad-gevul bet shamesh
Uvet shemesh kotzrim ketzir-chittim baemek vayyisu et-enehem vayyiru et-haaron vayyismechu lirot
Vehaagala baa el-sede yehoshua bet-hashshimshi vattaamod sham vesham even gedola vayevakkeu et-atze haagala veet-happarot heelu ola la-Adonai
Vehalviyyim horidu et-aron Adonai veet-haargaz asher-itto asher-bo chele-zahav vayyasimu el-haeven haggedola veanshe vet-shemesh heelu olot vayyizbechu zevachim bayyom hahu la-Adonai
Vachamishsha sarne-felishtim rau vayyashuvu ekron bayyom hahu
Veelle techore hazzahav asher heshivu felishtim asham la-Adonai leashdod echad leazza echad leashkelon echad legat echad leekron echad

Veachbere hazzahav mispar kal-are felishtim lachameshet hasseranim meir mivtzar vead kofer happerazi vead avel haggedola asher hinnichu aleha et aron Adonai ad hayyom hazze bisde yehoshua bet-hashshimshi
Vayyach beanshe vet-shemesh ki rau baaron Adonai vayyach baam shivim ish chamishshim elef ish vayyitabbelu haam ki-hikka Adonai baam makka gedola
Vayyomru anshe vet-shemesh mi yuchal laamod lifne Adonai haelohim hakkadosh hazze veel-mi yaale mealenu
Vayyishlechu malachim el-yoshve kiryat-yearim lemor heshivu felishtim et-aron Adonai redu haalu oto alechem
Vayyavou anshe kiryat yearim vayyaalu et-aron Adonai vayyaviu oto el-bet avinadav baggiva veet-elazar beno kiddeshu lishmor et-aron Adonai
Vayehi miyyom shevet haaron bekiryat yearim vayyirbu hayyamim vayyihyu esrim shana vayyinnahu kal-bet yisrael achare Adonai

Vayyomer shemuel el-kal-bet yisrael lemor im-bechal-levavchem attem shavim el-Adonai hasiru et-elohe hannechar mittochchem vehaashtarot vehachinu levavchem el-Adonai veivduhu levaddo veyatztzel etchem miyyad pelishtim
Vayyasiru bene yisrael et-habbealim veet-haashtarot vayyaavdu et-Adonai levaddo
Vayyomer shemuel kivtzu et-kal-yisrael hammitzpata veetpallel baadchem el-Adonai
Vayyikkavtzu hammitzpata vayyishavu-mayim vayyishpechu lifne Adonai vayyatzumu bayyom hahu vayyomru sham chatanu la-Adonai vayyishpot shemuel et-bene yisrael bammitzpa
Vayyishmeu felishtim ki-hitkabbetzu vene-yisrael hammitzpata vayyaalu sarne-felishtim el-yisrael vayyishmeu bene yisrael vayyiru mippene felishtim
Vayyomru vene-yisrael el-shemuel al-tacharesh mimmennu mizzeok el-Adonai elohenu veyoshienu miyyad pelishtim
Vayyikkach shemuel tele chalav echad vayyaalehu ola kalil la-Adonai vayyizak shemuel el-Adonai bead yisrael vayyaanehu Adonai
Vayehi shemuel maale haola uflishtim niggeshu lammilchama beyisrael vayyarem Adonai bekol-gadol bayyom hahu al-pelishtim vayehummem vayyinnagfu lifne yisrael
Vayyetzu anshe yisrael min-hammitzpa vayyirdefu et-pelishtim vayyakkum ad-mittachat levet kar
Vayyikkach shemuel even achat vayyasem ben-hammitzpa uven hashshen vayyikra et-shemah even haazer vayyomar ad-henna azaranu Adonai
Vayyikkanu happelishtim velo-yasfu od lavo bigvul yisrael vattehi yad-Adonai bappelishtim kol yeme shemuel
Vattashovna hearim asher lakchu-felishtim meet yisrael leyisrael meekron vead-gat veet-gevulan hitztzil yisrael miyyad pelishtim vayehi shalom ben yisrael uven haemori
Vayyishpot shemuel et-yisrael kol yeme chayyav
Vehalach midde shana beshana vesavav bet-el vehaggilgal vehammitzpa veshafat et-yisrael et kal-hammekomot haelle
Utshuvato haramata ki-sham beto vesham shafat et-yisrael vayyiven-sham mizbeach la-Adonai
Vayehi kaasher zaken shemuel vayyasem et-banav shoftim leyisrael
Vayehi shem-beno habbechor yoel veshem mishnehu aviyya shoftim biver shava
Velo-halchu vanav bidrachav vayyittu achare habbatza vayyikchu-shochad vayyattu mishpat
Vayyitkabbetzu kol zikne yisrael vayyavou el-shemuel haramata
Vayyomru elav hinne atta zakanta uvanecha lo halchu bidrachecha atta sima-lanu melech leshaftenu kechal-haggoyim
Vayyera haddavar beene shemuel kaasher amru tena-lanu melech leshaftenu vayyitpallel shemuel el-Adonai
Vayyomer Adonai el-shemuel shema bekol haam lechol asher-yomru elecha ki lo otcha maasu ki-oti maasu mimmeloch alehem
Kechal-hammaasim asher-asu miyyom haaloti otam mimmitzrayim vead-hayyom hazze vayyaazvuni vayyaavdu elohim acherim ken hemma osim gam-lach
Veatta shema bekolam ach ki-haed taid bahem vehiggadta lahem mishpat hammelech asher yimloch alehem
Vayyomer shemuel et kal-divre Adonai el-haam hashshoalim meitto melech
Vayyomer ze yihye mishpat hammelech asher yimloch alechem et-benechem yikkach vesam lo bemerkavto uvfarashav veratzu lifne merkavto
Velasum lo sare alafim vesare chamishshim velacharosh charisho veliktzor ketziro velaasot kele-milchamto uchle richbo
Veet-benotechem yikkach lerakkachot ultabbachot ulofot
Veet-sedotechem veet-karmechem vezetechem hattovim yikkach venatan laavadav
Vezarechem vecharmechem yasor venatan lesarisav velaavadav
Veet-avdechem veet-shifchotechem veet-bachurechem hattovim veet-chamorechem yikkach veasa limlachto
Tzonchem yasor veattem tihyu-lo laavadim
Uzaktem bayyom hahu millifne malkechem asher bechartem lachem velo-yaane Adonai etchem bayyom hahu
Vayemaanu haam lishmoa bekol shemuel vayyomru lo ki im-melech yihye alenu
Vehayinu gam-anachnu kechal-haggoyim ushfatanu malkenu veyatza lefanenu venilcham et-milchamotenu
Vayyishma shemuel et kal-divre haam vayedabberem beazne Adonai
Vayyomer Adonai el-shemuel shema bekolam vehimlachta lahem melech vayyomer shemuel el-anshe yisrael lechu ish leiro
Vayehi-ish mibbinyamin ushmo kish ben-aviel ben-tzeror ben-bechorat ben-afiach ben-ish yemini gibbor chayil
Velo-haya ven ushmo shaul bachur vatov veen ish mibbene yisrael tov mimmennu mishshichmo vamala gavoha mikkal-haam
Vattovadna haatonot lekish avi shaul vayyomer kish el-shaul beno kach-na ittecha et-achad mehannearim vekum lech bakkesh et-haatonot
Vayyaavor behar-efrayim vayyaavor beeretz-shalisha velo matzau vayyaavru veeretz-shaalim vaayin vayyaavor beeretz-yemini velo matzau
Hemma bau beeretz tzuf veshaul amar lenaaro asher-immo lecha venashuva pen-yechdal avi min-haatonot vedaag lanu
Vayyomer lo hinne-na ish-elohim bair hazzot vehaish nichbad kol asher-yedabber bo yavo atta nelacha sham ula yaggid lanu et-darkenu asher-halachnu aleha
Vayyomer shaul lenaaro vehinne nelech uma-navi laish ki hallechem azal mikkelenu utshura en-lehavi leish haelohim ma ittanu
Vayyosef hannaar laanot et-shaul vayyomer hinne nimtza veyadi reva shekel kasef venatatti leish haelohim vehiggid lanu et-darkenu
Lefanim beyisrael ko-amar haish belechto lidrosh elohim lechu venelcha ad-haroe ki lannavi hayyom yikkare lefanim haroe
Vayyomer shaul lenaaro tov devarcha lecha nelecha vayyelchu el-hair asher-sham ish haelohim
Hemma olim bemaale hair vehemma matzu nearot yotzot lishov mayim vayyomru lahen hayesh baze haroe
Vattaanena otam vattomarna yesh hinne lefanecha maher atta ki hayyom ba lair ki zevach hayyom laam babbama
Kevoachem hair ken timtzeun oto beterem yaale habbamata leechol ki lo-yochal haam ad-boo ki-hu yevarech hazzevach achare-chen yochlu hakkeruim veatta alu ki-oto chehayyom timtzeun oto
Vayyaalu hair hemma baim betoch hair vehinne shemuel yotze likratam laalot habbama
Va-Adonai gala et-ozen shemuel yom echad lifne vo-shaul lemor
Kaet machar eshlach elecha ish meeretz binyamin umshachto lenagid al-ammi yisrael vehoshia et-ammi miyyad pelishtim ki raiti et-ammi ki baa tzaakato ela
Ushmuel raa et-shaul va-Adonai anahu hinne haish asher amarti elecha ze yatzor beammi
Vayyiggash shaul et-shemuel betoch hashshaar vayyomer haggida-na li e-ze bet haroe
Vayyaan shemuel et-shaul vayyomer anochi haroe ale lefana habbama vaachaltem immi hayyom veshillachticha vabboker vechol asher bilvavcha aggid lach
Velaatonot haovdot lecha hayyom sheloshet hayyamim al-tasem et-libbecha lahem ki nimtzau ulmi kal-chemdat yisrael halo lecha ulchol bet avicha
Vayyaan shaul vayyomer halo ven-yemini anochi mikkatanne shivte yisrael umishpachti hatztzeira mikkal-mishpechot shivte vinyamin velamma dibbarta ela kaddavar hazze
Vayyikkach shemuel et-shaul veet-naaro vayeviem lishkata vayyitten lahem makom berosh hakkeruim vehemma kishloshim ish
Vayyomer shemuel lattabbach tena et-hammana asher natatti lach asher amarti elecha sim otah immach
Vayyarem hattabbach et-hashshok vehealeha vayyasem lifne shaul vayyomer hinne hannishar sim-lefanecha echol ki lammoed shamur-lecha lemor haam karati vayyochal shaul im-shemuel bayyom hahu
Vayyerdu mehabbama hair vayedabber im-shaul al-haggag
Vayyashkimu vayehi kaalot hashshachar vayyikra shemuel el-shaul haggaga lemor kuma vaashallechekka vayyakam shaul vayyetzu shenehem hu ushmuel hachutza
Hemma yordim biktze hair ushmuel amar el-shaul emor lannaar veyaavor lefanenu vayyaavor veatta amod kayyom veashmiacha et-devar elohim
Vayyikkach shemuel et-pach hashshemen vayyitzok al-rosho vayyishshakehu vayyomer halo ki-meshachacha Adonai al-nachalato lenagid

Belechtecha hayyom meimmadi umatzata shene anashim im-kevurat rachel bigvul binyamin betzeltzach veamru elecha nimtzeu haatonot asher halachta levakkesh vehinne natash avicha et-divre haatonot vedaag lachem lemor ma eese livni
Vechalafta mishsham vahala uvata ad-elon tavor umtzaucha sham shelosha anashim olim el-haelohim bet-el echad nose shelosha gedayim veechad nose sheloshet kikkerot lechem veechad nose nevel-yayin
Veshaalu lecha leshalom venatnu lecha shette-lechem velakachta miyyadam
Achar ken tavo givat haelohim asher-sham netzive felishtim vihi chevoacha sham hair ufagata chevel neviim yordim mehabbama velifnehem nevel vetof vechalil vechinnor vehemma mitnabbeim
Vetzalcha alecha ruach Adonai vehitnabbita immam venehpachta leish acher
Vehaya ki tavona haotot haelle lach ase lecha asher timtza yadecha ki haelohim immach
Veyaradta lefana haggilgal vehinne anochi yored elecha lehaalot olot lizboach zivche shelamim shivat yamim tochel ad-boi elecha vehodati lecha et asher taase
Vehaya kehafnoto shichmo lalechet meim shemuel vayyahafach-lo elohim lev acher vayyavou kal-haotot haelle bayyom hahu
Vayyavou sham haggivata vehinne chevel-neviim likrato vattitzlach alav ruach elohim vayyitnabbe betocham
Vayehi kal-yodo meittemol shilshom vayyiru vehinne im-neviim nibba vayyomer haam ish el-reehu ma-ze haya leven-kish hagam shaul banneviim
Vayyaan ish mishsham vayyomer umi avihem al-ken hayeta lemashal hagam shaul banneviim
Vayechal mehitnabbot vayyavo habbama
Vayyomer dod shaul elav veel-naaro an halachtem vayyomer levakkesh et-haatonot vannire chi-ayin vannavo el-shemuel
Vayyomer dod shaul haggida-na li ma-amar lachem shemuel
Vayyomer shaul el-dodo hagged higgid lanu ki nimtzeu haatonot veet-devar hammelucha lo-higgid lo asher amar shemuel
Vayyatzek shemuel et-haam el-Adonai hammitzpa
Vayyomer el-bene yisrael f ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael anochi heeleti et-yisrael mimmitzrayim vaatztzil etchem miyyad mitzrayim umiyyad kal-hammamlachot hallochatzim etchem
Veattem hayyom meastem et-elohechem asher-hu moshia lachem mikkal-raotechem vetzarotechem vattomru lo ki-melech tasim alenu veatta hityatztzevu lifne Adonai leshivtechem ulalfechem
Vayyakrev shemuel et kal-shivte yisrael vayyillached shevet binyamin
Vayyakrev et-shevet binyamin lemishpechotav vattillached mishpachat hammatri vayyillached shaul ben-kish vayevakshuhu velo nimtza
Vayyishalu-od ba-Adonai hava od halom ish s vayyomer Adonai hinne-hu nechba el-hakkelim
Vayyarutzu vayyikkachuhu mishsham vayyityatztzev betoch haam vayyigbah mikkal-haam mishshichmo vamala
Vayyomer shemuel el-kal-haam harreitem asher bachar-bo Adonai ki en kamohu bechal-haam vayyariu chal-haam vayyomru yechi hammelech
Vayedabber shemuel el-haam et mishpat hammelucha vayyichtov bassefer vayyannach lifne Adonai vayeshallach shemuel et-kal-haam ish leveto
Vegam-shaul halach leveto givata vayyelchu immo hachayil asher-naga elohim belibbam
Uvne veliyyaal amru ma-yoshienu ze vayyivzuhu velo-heviu lo mincha vayehi kemacharish
Vayyaal nachash haammoni vayyichan al-yavesh gilad vayyomru kal-anshe yavesh el-nachash kerat-lanu verit venaavdekka
Vayyomer alehem nachash haammoni bezot echrot lachem binkor lachem kal-en yamin vesamtiha cherpa al-kal-yisrael
Vayyomru elav zikne yavesh heref lanu shivat yamim venishlecha malachim bechol gevul yisrael veim-en moshia otanu veyatzanu elecha
Vayyavou hammalachim givat shaul vayedabberu haddevarim beazne haam vayyisu chal-haam et-kolam vayyivku
Vehinne shaul ba achare habbakar min-hassade vayyomer shaul ma-laam ki yivku vayesapperu-lo et-divre anshe yavesh
Vattitzlach ruach-elohim al-shaul keshamo et-haddevarim haelle vayyichar appo meod

Vayyikkach tzemed bakar vayenattechehu vayeshallach bechal-gevul yisrael beyad hammalachim lemor asher enennu yotze achare shaul veachar shemuel ko yease livkaro vayyippol pachad-Adonai al-haam vayyetzu keish echad
Vayyifkedem bevazek vayyihyu vene-yisrael shelosh meot elef veish yehuda sheloshim alef
Vayyomru lammalachim habbaim ko tomrun leish yavesh gilad machar tihye-lachem teshua kechom hashshamesh vayyavou hammalachim vayyaggidu leanshe yavesh vayyismachu
Vayyomru anshe yavesh machar netze alechem vaasitem lanu kechal-hattov beenechem

Vayehi mimmachorat vayyasem shaul et-haam shelosha rashim vayyavou vetoch-hammachane beashmoret habboker vayyakku et-ammon ad-chom hayyom vayehi hannisharim vayyafutzu velo nisharu-vam shenayim yachad
Vayyomer haam el-shemuel mi haomer shaul yimloch alenu tenu haanashim unmitem
Vayyomer shaul lo-yumat ish bayyom hazze ki hayyom asa-Adonai teshua beyisrael
Vayyomer shemuel el-haam lechu venelcha haggilgal unchaddesh sham hammelucha
Vayyelchu chal-haam haggilgal vayyamlichu sham et-shaul lifne Adonai baggilgal vayyizbechu-sham zevachim shelamim lifne Adonai vayyismach sham shaul vechal-anshe yisrael ad-meod
Vayyomer shemuel el-kal-yisrael hinne shamati vekolchem lechol asher-amartem li vaamlich alechem melech
Veatta hinne hammelech mithallech lifnechem vaani zakanti vasavti uvana hinnam ittechem vaani hithallachti lifnechem minneura ad-hayyom hazze
Hinni anu vi neged Adonai veneged meshicho et-shor mi lakachti vachamor mi lakachti veet-mi ashakti et-mi ratztzoti umiyyad-mi lakachti chofer vealim ena bo veashiv lachem
Vayyomru lo ashaktanu velo ratztzotanu velo-lakachta miyyad-ish meuma
Vayyomer alehem ed Adonai bachem veed meshicho hayyom hazze ki lo metzatem beyadi meuma vayyomer ed
Vayyomer shemuel el-haam Adonai asher asa et-moshe veet-aharon vaasher heela et-avotechem meeretz mitzrayim
Veatta hityatztzevu veishshafta ittechem lifne Adonai et kal-tzidkot Adonai asher-asa ittechem veet-avotechem
Kaasher-ba yaakov mitzrayim vayyizaku avotechem el-Adonai vayyishlach Adonai et-moshe veet-aharon vayyotziu et-avotechem mimmitzrayim vayyoshivum bammakom hazze
Vayyishkechu et-Adonai elohehem vayyimkor otam beyad sisra sar-tzeva chatzor uvyad-pelishtim uvyad melech moav vayyillachamu bam
Vayyizaku el-Adonai vayyomru chatanu ki azavnu et-Adonai vannaavod et-habbealim veet-haashtarot veatta hatztzilenu miyyad oyevenu venaavdekka
Vayyishlach Adonai et-yerubbaal veet-bedan veet-yiftach veet-shemuel vayyatztzel etchem miyyad oyevechem missaviv vatteshvu betach
Vattiru ki-nachash melech bene-ammon ba alechem vattomru li lo ki-melech yimloch alenu va-Adonai elohechem malkechem
Veatta hinne hammelech asher bechartem asher sheeltem vehinne natan Adonai alechem melech
Im-tiru et-Adonai vaavadtem oto ushmatem bekolo velo tamru et-pi Adonai vihyitem gam-attem vegam-hammelech asher malach alechem achar Adonai elohechem
Veim-lo tishmeu bekol Adonai umritem et-pi Adonai vehayeta yad-Adonai bachem uvaavotechem
Gam-atta hityatztzevu uru et-haddavar haggadol hazze asher Adonai ose leenechem
Halo ketzir-chittim hayyom ekra el-Adonai veyitten kolot umatar udu uru ki-raatchem rabba asher asitem beene Adonai lishol lachem melech
Vayyikra shemuel el-Adonai vayyitten Adonai kolot umatar bayyom hahu vayyira chal-haam meod et-Adonai veet-shemuel
Vayyomru chal-haam el-shemuel hitpallel bead-avadecha el-Adonai elohecha veal-namut ki-yasafnu al-kal-chattotenu raa lishol lanu melech

Vattomer linareha ivru lefana hinni acharechem baa ulishah naval lo higgida

Veet-achinoam lakach david miyyizreel vattihyena gam-shettehen lo lenashim

Vayyavou hazzifim el-shaul haggivata lemor halo david mistatter begivat hachachila al pene hayeshimon

Vayyirdof david hu vearba-meot ish vayyaamdu matayim ish asher piggeru meavor et-nachal habbesor
Vayyimtzeu ish-mitzri bassade vayyikchu oto el-david vayyittenu-lo lechem vayyochal vayyashkuhu mayim
Vayyittenu-lo felach devela ushne tzimmukim vayyochal vattashav rucho elav ki lo-achal lechem velo-shata mayim shelosha yamim ushlosha lelot
Vayyomer lo david lemi-atta vee mizze atta vayyomer naar mitzri anochi eved leish amaleki vayyaazveni adoni ki chaliti hayyom shelosha
Anachnu pashatnu negev hakkereti veal-asher lihuda veal-negev kalev veet-tziklag sarafnu vaesh
Vayyomer elav david hatorideni el-haggedud hazze vayyomer hishshava li velohim im-temiteni veim-tasgireni beyad-adoni veoridcha el-haggedud hazze
Vayyoridehu vehinne netushim al-pene chal-haaretz ochlim veshotim vechoggim bechol hashshalal haggadol asher lakchu meeretz pelishtim umeeretz yehuda
Vayyakkem david mehanneshef vead-haerev lemachoratam velo-nimlat mehem ish ki im-arba meot ish-naar asher-rachvu al-haggemallim vayyanusu
Vayyatztzel david et kal-asher lakchu amalek veet-shette nashav hitztzil david
Velo nedar-lahem min-hakkaton vead-haggadol vead-banim uvanot umishshalal vead kal-asher lakchu lahem hakkol heshiv david
Vayyikkach david et-kal-hatztzon vehabbakar nahagu lifne hammikne hahu vayyomru ze shelal david
Vayyavo david el-matayim haanashim asher-piggeru millechet achare david vayyoshivum benachal habbesor vayyetzu likrat david velikrat haam asher-itto vayyiggash david et-haam vayyishal lahem leshalom
Vayyaan kal-ish-ra uvliyyaal mehaanashim asher halchu im-david vayyomru yaan asher lo-halchu immi lo-nitten lahem mehashshalal asher hitztzalnu ki-im-ish et-ishto veet-banav veyinhagu veyelechu
Vayyomer david lo-taasu chen echa et asher-natan Adonai lanu vayyishmor otanu vayyitten et-haggedud habba alenu beyadenu
Umi yishma lachem laddavar hazze ki kechelek hayyored bammilchama uchchelek hayyoshev al-hakkelim yachdav yachaloku
Vayehi mehayyom hahu vamala vayesimeha lechok ulmishpat leyisrael ad hayyom hazze
Vayyavo david el-tziklag vayeshallach mehashshalal lezikne yehuda lereehu lemor hinne lachem beracha mishshelal oyeve Adonai
Laasher bevet-el velaasher beramot-negev velaasher beyattir
Velaasher baaroer velaasher besifmot velaasher beeshtemoa
Velaasher berachal velaasher beare hayerachmeeli velaasher beare hakkeni
Velaasher becharma velaasher bevor-ashan velaasher baatach
Velaasher bechevron ulchal-hammekomot asher-hithallech-sham david hu vaanashav
Uflishtim nilchamim beyisrael vayyanusu anshe yisrael mippene felishtim vayyippelu chalalim behar haggilboa
Vayyadbeku felishtim et-shaul veet-banav vayyakku felishtim et-yehonatan veet-avinadav veet-malki-shua bene shaul

Vayyomer david el-hannaar hammaggid lo ech yadata ki-met shaul vihonatan beno

Vayyifen acharav vayyireni vayyikra ela vaomar hinneni
Vayyomer li mi-atta vaomar elav amaleki anochi
Vayyomer ela amad-na ala umotteni ki achazani hashshavatz ki-chal-od nafshi bi

Vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem vegam kal-haanashim asher itto
Vayyispedu vayyivku vayyatzumu ad-haarev al-shaul veal-yehonatan beno veal-am Adonai veal-bet yisrael ki naflu becharev

Hatztzevi yisrael al-bamotecha chalal ech naflu gibborim
Al-taggidu vegat al-tevasseru bechutzot ashkelon pen-tismachna benot pelishtim pen-taalozna benot haarelim
Hare vaggilboa al-tal veal-matar alechem usde terumot ki sham nigal magen gibborim magen shaul beli mashiach bashshamen
Middam chalalim mechelev gibborim keshet yehonatan lo nasog achor vecherev shaul lo tashuv rekam
Shaul vihonatan hanneehavim vehanneimim bechayyehem uvmotam lo nifradu minnesharim kallu mearaot gaveru
Benot yisrael el-shaul bechena hammalbishchem shani im-adanim hammaale adi zahav al levushchen
Ech naflu gibborim betoch hammilchama yehonatan al-bamotecha chalal
Tzar-li alecha achi yehonatan naamta li meod nifleata ahavatcha li meahavat nashim
Ech naflu gibborim vayyovdu kele milchama
Vayehi achare-chen vayyishal david ba-Adonai lemor haeele beachat are yehuda vayyomer Adonai elav ale vayyomer david ana eele vayyomer chevrona
Vayyaal sham david vegam shette nashav achinoam hayyizreelit vaavigayil eshet naval hakkarmeli
Vaanashav asher-immo heela david ish uveto vayyeshvu beare chevron
Vayyavou anshe yehuda vayyimshechu-sham et-david lemelech al-bet yehuda vayyaggidu ledavid lemor anshe yavesh gilad asher kavru et-shaul
Vayyishlach david malachim el-anshe yavesh gilad vayyomer alehem beruchim attem la-Adonai asher asitem hachesed hazze im-adonechem im-shaul vattikberu oto
Veatta yaas-Adonai immachem chesed veemet vegam anochi eese ittechem hattova hazzot asher asitem haddavar hazze
Veatta techezakna yedechem vihyu livne-chayil ki-met adonechem shaul vegam-oti mashchu vet-yehuda lemelech alehem
Veavner ben-ner sar-tzava asher leshaul lakach et-ish boshet ben-shaul vayyaavirehu machanayim
Vayyamlichehu el-haggilad veel-haashuri veel-yizreel veal-efrayim veal-binyamin veal-yisrael kullo
Ben-arbaim shana ish-boshet ben-shaul bemalcho al-yisrael ushtayim shanim malach ach bet yehuda hau achare david
Vayehi mispar hayyamim asher haya david melech bechevron al-bet yehuda sheva shanim veshishsha chodashim
Vayyetze avner ben-ner veavde ish-boshet ben-shaul mimmachanayim givona
Veoav ben-tzeruya veavde david yatzu vayyifgeshum al-berechat givon yachdav vayyeshvu elle al-habberecha mizze veelle al-habberecha mizze
Vayyomer avner el-yoav yakumu na hannearim visachaku lefanenu vayyomer yoav yakumu

Vayyachaziku ish berosh reehu vecharbo betzad reehu vayyippelu yachdav vayyikra lammakom hahu chelkat hatztzurim asher begivon
Vattehi hammilchama kasha ad-meod bayyom hahu vayyinnagef avner veanshe yisrael lifne avde david

Uflishtim bau vayyinnatshu beemek refaim

Vayyosifu od pelishtim laalot vayyinnatshu beemek refaim

Vihi keshamacha et-kol tzeada berashe habbechaim az techeratz ki az yatza Adonai lefanecha lehakkot bemachane felishtim
Vayyaas david ken kaasher tzivahu Adonai vayyach et-pelishtim miggeva ad-boacha gazer
Vayyosef od david et-kal-bachur beyisrael sheloshim alef
Vayyakam vayyelech david vechal-haam asher itto mibbaale yehuda lehaalot mishsham et aron haelohim asher-nikra shem shem Adonai tzevaot yoshev hakkeruvim alav
Vayyarkivu et-aron haelohim el-agala chadasha vayyissauhu mibbet avinadav asher baggiva veuzza veachyo bene avinadav nohagim et-haagala chadasha
Vayyissauhu mibbet avinadav asher baggiva im aron haelohim veachyo holech lifne haaron
Vedavid vechal-bet yisrael mesachakim lifne Adonai bechol atze veroshim uvchinnorot uvinvalim uvtuppim uvimnaanim uvtzeltzelim
Vayyavou ad-goren nachon vayyishlach uzza el-aron haelohim vayyochez bo ki shamtu habbakar
Vayyichar-af Adonai beuzza vayyakkehu sham haelohim al-hashshal vayyamat sham im aron haelohim
Vayyichar ledavid al asher paratz Adonai peretz beuzza vayyikra lammakom hahu peretz uzza ad hayyom hazze
Vayyira david et-Adonai bayyom hahu vayyomer ech yavo ela aron Adonai
Velo-ava david lehasir elav et-aron Adonai al-ir david vayyattehu david bet oved-edom haggitti
Vayyeshev aron Adonai bet oved edom haggitti shelosha chodashim vayevarech Adonai et-oved edom veet-kal-beto
Vayyuggad lammelech david lemor berach Adonai et-bet oved edom veet-kal-asher-lo baavur aron haelohim vayyelech david vayyaal et-aron haelohim mibbet oved edom ir david besimcha
Vayehi ki tzaadu nose aron-Adonai shishsha tzeadim vayyizbach shor umri
Vedavid mecharker bechal-oz lifne Adonai vedavid chagur efod bad
Vedavid vechal-bet yisrael maalim et-aron Adonai bitrua uvkol shofar
Vehaya aron Adonai ba ir david umichal bat-shaul nishkefa bead hachallon vattere et-hammelech david mefazzez umcharker lifne Adonai vattivez lo belibbah
Vayyaviu et-aron Adonai vayyatztzigu oto bimkomo betoch haohel asher nata-lo david vayyaal david olot lifne Adonai ushlamim
Vayechal david mehaalot haola vehashshelamim vayevarech et-haam beshem Adonai tzevaot
Vayechallek lechal-haam lechal-hamon yisrael lemeish vead-ishsha leish challat lechem achat veeshpar echad vaashisha echat vayyelech kal-haam ish leveto
Vayyashav david levarech et-beto vattetze michal bat-shaul likrat david vattomer ma-nichbad hayyom melech yisrael asher nigla hayyom leene amhot avadav kehiggalot niglot achad harekim
Vayyomer david el-michal lifne Adonai asher bachar-bi meavich umikkal-beto letzaot oti nagid al-am Adonai al-yisrael vesichakti lifne Adonai
Unkalloti od mizzot vehayiti shafal beena veim-haamahot asher amarte immam ikkaveda
Ulmichal bat-shaul lo-haya lah yaled ad yom motah
Vayehi ki-yashav hammelech beveto va-Adonai heniach-lo missaviv mikkal-oyevav
Vayyomer hammelech el-natan hannavi ree na anochi yoshev bevet arazim vaaron haelohim yoshev betoch hayeria
Vayyomer natan el-hammelech kol asher bilvavcha lech ase ki Adonai immach
Vayehi ballayela hahu vayehi devar-Adonai el-natan lemor
Lech veamarta el-avdi el-david ko amar Adonai haatta tivne-li vayit leshivti
Ki lo yashavti bevayit lemiyyom haaloti et-bene yisrael mimmitzrayim vead hayyom hazze vaehye mithallech beohel uvmishkan
Bechol asher-hithallachti bechal-bene yisrael hadavar dibbarti et-achad shivte yisrael asher tziviti lirot et-ammi et-yisrael lemor lamma lo-venitem li bet arazim
Veatta ko-tomar leavdi ledavid ko amar Adonai tzevaot ani lekachticha min-hannave meachar hatztzon lihyot nagid al-ammi al-yisrael
Vaehye immecha bechol asher halachta vaachrita et-kal-oyevecha mippanecha veasiti lecha shem gadol keshem haggedolim asher baaretz
Vesamti makom leammi leyisrael untativ veshachan tachtav velo yirgaz od velo-yosifu vene-avela leannoto kaasher barishona
Ulmin-hayyom asher tziviti shoftim al-ammi yisrael vahanichoti lecha mikkal-oyevecha vehiggid lecha Adonai ki-vayit yaase-lecha Adonai
Ki yimleu yamecha veshachavta et-avotecha vahakimoti et-zaracha acharecha asher yetze mimmeecha vahachinoti et-mamlachto
Hu yivne-bayit lishmi vechonanti et-kisse mamlachto ad-olam
Ani ehye-lo leav vehu yihye-li leven asher behaaoto vehochachtiv beshevet anashim uvnige bene adam
Vechasdi lo-yasur mimmennu kaasher hasiroti meim shaul asher hasiroti millefanecha
Veneman betcha umamlachtecha ad-olam lefanecha kisacha yihye nachon ad-olam
Kechol haddevarim haelle uchchol hachizzaon hazze ken dibber natan el-david
Vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai vayyomer mi anochi adona Adonai umi veti ki haviotani ad-halom
Vattiktan od zot beenecha adona Adonai vattedabber gam el-bet-avdecha lemerachok vezot torat haadam adona Adonai
Uma-yosif david od ledabber elecha veatta yadata et-avdecha adona Adonai
Baavur devarcha uchlibbecha asita et kal-haggedulla hazzot lehodia et-avdecha
Al-ken gadalta adona Adonai ki-en kamocha veen elohim zulatecha bechol asher-shamanu beaznenu

Umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz asher halchu-elohim lifdot-lo leam velasum lo shem velaasot lachem haggedulla venoraot leartzecha mippene ammecha asher padita lecha mimmitzrayim goyim velohav
Vattechonen lecha et-ammecha yisrael lecha leam ad-olam veatta Adonai hayita lahem lelohim
Veatta Adonai elohim haddavar asher dibbarta al-avdecha veal-beto hakem ad-olam vaase kaasher dibbarta
Veyigdal shimcha ad-olam lemor Adonai tzevaot elohim al-yisrael uvet avdecha david yihye nachon lefanecha
Ki-atta Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael galita et-ozen avdecha lemor bayit evne-lach al-ken matza avdecha et-libbo lehitpallel elecha et-hattefilla hazzot
Veatta adona Adonai atta-hu haelohim udvarecha yihyu emet vattedabber el-avdecha et-hattova hazzot
Veatta hoel uvarech et-bet avdecha lihyot leolam lefanecha ki-atta adona Adonai dibbarta umibbirchatcha yevorach bet-avdecha leolam
Vayehi achare-chen vayyach david et-pelishtim vayyachniem vayyikkach david et-meteg haamma miyyad pelishtim
Vayyach et-moav vayemaddedem bachevel hashkev otam artza vayemadded shene-chavalim lehamit umlo hachevel lehachaot vattehi moav ledavid laavadim nose mincha
Vayyach david et-hadadezer ben-rechov melech tzova belechto lehashiv yado binhar-perat
Vayyilkod david mimmennu elef ushva-meot parashim veesrim elef ish ragli vayeakker david et-kal-harechev vayyoter mimmennu mea rachev
Vattavo aram dammesek lazor lahadadezer melech tzova vayyach david baaram esrim-ushnayim elef ish
Vayyasem david netzivim baaram dammesek vattehi aram ledavid laavadim nose mincha vayyosha Adonai et-david bechol asher halach
Vayyikkach david et shilte hazzahav asher hau el avde hadadazer vayeviem yerushalam
Umibbetach umibberota are hadadazer lakach hammelech david nechoshet harbe meod
Vayyishma toi melech chamat ki hikka david et kal-chel hadadazer

Vayyishlach toi et-yoram-beno el-hammelech-david lishal-lo leshalom ulvaracho al asher nilcham bahadadezer vayyakkehu ki-ish milchamot toi haya hadadazer uvyado hau kele-chesef uchle-zahav uchle nechoshet
Gam-otam hikdish hammelech david la-Adonai im-hakkesef vehazzahav asher hikdish mikkal-haggoyim asher kibbesh
Mearam umimmoav umibbene ammon umippelishtim umeamalek umishshelal hadadezer ben-rechov melech tzova
Vayyaas david shem beshuvo mehakkoto et-aram bege-melach shemona asar alef
Vayyasem beedom netzivim bechal-edom sam netzivim vayehi chal-edom avadim ledavid vayyosha Adonai et-david bechol asher halach
Vayyimloch david al-kal-yisrael vayehi david ose mishpat utzdaka lechal-ammo
Veoav ben-tzeruya al-hatztzava vihoshafat ben-achilud mazkir
Vetzadok ben-achituv vaachimelech ben-evyatar kohanim usraya sofer
Uvnayahu ben-yehoyada vehakkereti vehappeleti uvne david kohanim hau
Vayyomer david hachi yesh-od asher notar levet shaul veeese immo chesed baavur yehonatan
Ulvet shaul eved ushmo tziva vayyikreu-lo el-david vayyomer hammelech elav haatta tziva vayyomer avdecha
Vayyomer hammelech haefes od ish levet shaul veeese immo chesed elohim vayyomer tziva el-hammelech od ben lihonatan neche raglayim
Vayyomer-lo hammelech efo hu vayyomer tziva el-hammelech hinne-hu bet machir ben-ammiel belo devar
Vayyishlach hammelech david vayyikkachehu mibbet machir ben-ammiel millo devar
Vayyavo mefivoshet ben-yehonatan ben-shaul el-david vayyippol al-panav vayyishtachu vayyomer david mefivoshet vayyomer hinne avdecha
Vayyomer lo david al-tira ki aso eese immecha chesed baavur yehonatan avicha vahashivoti lecha et-kal-sede shaul avicha veatta tochal lechem al-shulchani tamid
Vayyishtachu vayyomer me avdecha ki fanita el-hakkelev hammet asher kamoni
Vayyikra hammelech el-tziva naar shaul vayyomer elav kol asher haya leshaul ulchal-beto natatti leven-adonecha
Veavadta lo et-haadama atta uvanecha vaavadecha veheveta vehaya leven-adonecha lechem vaachalo umfivoshet ben-adonecha yochal tamid lechem al-shulchani ultziva chamishsha asar banim veesrim avadim
Vayyomer tziva el-hammelech kechol asher yetzave adoni hammelech et-avdo ken yaase avdecha umfivoshet ochel al-shulchani keachad mibbene hammelech
Velimfivoshet ben-katan ushmo micha vechol moshav bet-tziva avadim limfivoshet
Umfivoshet yoshev birushalam ki al-shulchan hammelech tamid hu ochel vehu pisseach shette raglav
Vayehi achare-chen vayyamat melech bene ammon vayyimloch chanun beno tachtav
Vayyomer david eese-chesed im-chanun ben-nachash kaasher asa aviv immadi chesed vayyishlach david lenachamo beyad-avadav el-aviv vayyavou avde david eretz bene ammon
Vayyomru sare vene-ammon el-chanun adonehem hamchabbed david et-avicha beenecha ki-shalach lecha menachamim halo baavur chakor et-hair ulraggelah ulhafchah shalach david et-avadav elecha
Vayyikkach chanun et-avde david vayegallach et-chatzi zekanam vayyichrot et-madvehem bachetzi ad shetotehem vayeshallechem
Vayyaggidu ledavid vayyishlach likratam ki-hau haanashim nichlamim meod vayyomer hammelech shevu virecho ad-yetzammach zekanchem veshavtem
Vayyiru bene ammon ki nivashu bedavid vayyishlechu vene-ammon vayyiskeru et-aram bet-rechov veet-aram tzova esrim elef ragli veet-melech maacha elef ish veish tov shenem-asar elef ish
Vayyishma david vayyishlach et-yoav veet kal-hatztzava haggibborim
Vayyetzu bene ammon vayyaarchu milchama petach hashshaar vaaram tzova urchov veish-tov umaacha levaddam bassade
Vayyar yoav ki-hayeta elav pene hammilchama mippanim umeachor vayyivchar mikkol bechure yisrael vayyaaroch likrat aram
Veet yeter haam natan beyad avsha achiv vayyaaroch likrat bene ammon
Vayyomer im-techezak aram mimmenni vehayita li lishua veim-bene ammon yechezku mimmecha vehalachti lehoshia lach
Chazak venitchazzak bead-ammenu uvad are elohenu va-Adonai yaase hattov beenav
Vayyiggash yoav vehaam asher immo lammilchama baaram vayyanusu mippanav
Uvne ammon rau ki-nas aram vayyanusu mippene avisha vayyavou hair vayyashav yoav meal bene ammon vayyavo yerushalam
Vayyar aram ki niggaf lifne yisrael vayyeasfu yachad
Vayyishlach hadadezer vayyotze et-aram asher meever hannahar vayyavou chelam veshovach sar-tzeva hadadezer lifnehem
Vayyuggad ledavid s vayyeesof et-kal-yisrael vayyaavor et-hayyarden vayyavo chelama vayyaarchu aram likrat david vayyillachamu immo
Vayyanas aram mippene yisrael vayyaharog david mearam sheva meot rechev vearbaim elef parashim veet shovach sar-tzevao hikka vayyamat sham
Vayyiru chal-hammelachim avde hadadezer ki niggefu lifne yisrael vayyashlimu et-yisrael vayyaavdum vayyiru aram lehoshia od et-bene ammon
Vayehi litshuvat hashshana leet tzet hammalchim vayyishlach david et-yoav veet-avadav immo veet-kal-yisrael vayyashchitu et-bene ammon vayyatzuru al-rabba vedavid yoshev birushalam
Vayehi leet haerev vayyakam david meal mishkavo vayyithallech al-gag bet-hammelech vayyar ishsha rochetzet meal haggag vehaishsha tovat mare meod
Vayyishlach david vayyidrosh laishsha vayyomer halo-zot bat-sheva bat-eliam eshet uriyya hachitti
Vayyishlach david malachim vayyikkacheha vattavo elav vayyishkav immah vehi mitkaddeshet mittumatah vattashav el-betah
Vattahar haishsha vattishlach vattagged ledavid vattomer hara anochi
Vayyishlach david el-yoav shelach ela et-uriyya hachitti vayyishlach yoav et-uriyya el-david
Vayyavo uriyya elav vayyishal david lishlom yoav velishlom haam velishlom hammilchama
Vayyomer david leuriyya red levetcha urchatz raglecha vayyetze uriyya mibbet hammelech vattetze acharav masat hammelech
Vayyishkav uriyya petach bet hammelech et kal-avde adonav velo yarad el-beto
Vayyaggidu ledavid lemor lo-yarad uriyya el-beto vayyomer david el-uriyya halo midderech atta va maddua lo-yaradta el-betecha

Vayyomer uriyya el-david haaron veyisrael vihuda yoshvim bassukkot vadoni yoav veavde adoni al-pene hassade chonim vaani avo el-beti leechol velishtot velishkav im-ishti chayyecha veche nafshecha im-eese et-haddavar hazze
Vayyomer david el-uriyya shev baze gam-hayyom umachar ashallechekka vayyeshev uriyya virushalam bayyom hahu umimmachorat
Vayyikra-lo david vayyochal lefanav vayyeshte vayeshakkerehu vayyetze vaerev lishkav bemishkavo im-avde adonav veel-beto lo yarad
Vayehi vabboker vayyichtov david sefer el-yoav vayyishlach beyad uriyya
Vayyichtov bassefer lemor havu et-uriyya el-mul pene hammilchama hachazaka veshavtem meacharav venikka vamet
Vayehi bishmor yoav el-hair vayyitten et-uriyya el-hammakom asher yada ki anshe-chayil sham
Vayyetzu anshe hair vayyillachamu et-yoav vayyippol min-haam meavde david vayyamat gam uriyya hachitti
Vayyishlach yoav vayyagged ledavid et-kal-divre hammilchama
Vayetzav et-hammalach lemor kechallotcha et kal-divre hammilchama ledabber el-hammelech
Vehaya im-taale chamat hammelech veamar lecha maddua niggashtem el-hair lehillachem halo yedatem et asher-yoru meal hachoma
Mi-hikka et-avimelech ben-yerubbeshet halo-ishsha hishlicha alav pelach rechev meal hachoma vayyamat betevetz lamma niggashtem el-hachoma veamarta gam avdecha uriyya hachitti met
Vayyelech hammalach vayyavo vayyagged ledavid et kal-asher shelacho yoav
Vayyomer hammalach el-david ki-gavru alenu haanashim vayyetzu elenu hassade vannihye alehem ad-petach hashshaar
Vayyoru hammorim el-avadecha meal hachoma vayyamutu meavde hammelech vegam avdecha uriyya hachitti met
Vayyomer david el-hammalach ko-tomar el-yoav al-yera beenecha et-haddavar hazze ki-chazo vechaze tochal hecharev hachazek milchamtecha el-hair veharsah vechazzekehu
Vattishma eshet uriyya ki-met uriyya ishah vattispod al-balah
Vayyaavor haevel vayyishlach david vayyaasfah el-beto vattehi-lo leishsha vatteled lo ben vayyera haddavar asher-asa david beene Adonai
Vayyishlach Adonai et-natan el-david vayyavo elav vayyomer lo shene anashim hau beir echat echad ashir veechad rash
Leashir haya tzon uvakar harbe meod
Velarash en-kol ki im-kivsa achat ketanna asher kana vayechayyeha vattigdal immo veim-banav yachdav mippitto tochal umikkoso tishte uvcheko tishkav vattehi-lo kevat
Vayyavo helech leish heashir vayyachmol lakachat mitztzono umibbekaro laasot laoreach habba-lo vayyikkach et-kivsat haish harash vayyaaseha laish habba elav
Vayyichar-af david baish meod vayyomer el-natan cha-Adonai ki ven-mavet haish haose zot
Veet-hakkivsa yeshallem arbatayim ekev asher asa et-haddavar hazze veal asher lo-chamal
Vayyomer natan el-david atta haish ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael anochi meshachticha lemelech al-yisrael veanochi hitztzalticha miyyad shaul
Vaettena lecha et-bet adonecha veet-neshe adonecha bechekecha vaettena lecha et-bet yisrael vihuda veim-meat veosifa lecha kahenna vechahenna
Maddua bazita et-devar Adonai laasot hara beena et uriyya hachitti hikkita vacherev veet-ishto lakachta lecha leishsha veoto haragta becherev bene ammon
Veatta lo-tasur cherev mibbetcha ad-olam ekev ki vezitani vattikkach et-eshet uriyya hachitti lihyot lecha leishsha
Ko amar Adonai hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha velakachti et-nashecha leenecha venatatti lereecha veshachav im-nashecha leene hashshemesh hazzot
Ki atta asita vassater vaani eese et-haddavar hazze neged kal-yisrael veneged hashshamesh
Vayyomer david el-natan chatati la-Adonai s vayyomer natan el-david gam-Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut
Efes ki-nietz niatzta et-oyeve Adonai baddavar hazze gam habben hayyillod lecha mot yamut
Vayyelech natan el-beto vayyiggof Adonai et-hayyeled asher yalda eshet-uriyya ledavid vayyeanash
Vayevakkesh david et-haelohim bead hannaar vayyatzam david tzom uva velan veshachav artza
Vayyakumu zikne veto alav lahakimo min-haaretz velo ava velo-vara ittam lachem
Vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyamat hayyaled vayyiru avde david lehaggid lo ki-met hayyeled ki amru hinne vihyot hayyeled cha dibbarnu elav velo-shama bekolenu veech nomar elav met hayyeled veasa raa
Vayyar david ki avadav mitlachashim vayyaven david ki met hayyaled vayyomer david el-avadav hamet hayyeled vayyomru met
Vayyakam david mehaaretz vayyirchatz vayyasech vayechallef simlotav vayyavo vet-Adonai vayyishtachu vayyavo el-beto vayyishal vayyasimu lo lechem vayyochal
Vayyomru avadav elav ma-haddavar hazze asher asita baavur hayyeled cha tzamta vattevke vechaasher met hayyeled kamta vattochal lachem
Vayyomer beod hayyeled cha tzamti vaevke ki amarti mi yodea vechannani Adonai vecha hayyaled
Veatta met lamma ze ani tzam hauchal lahashivo od ani holech elav vehu lo-yashuv ela
Vayenachem david et bat-sheva ishto vayyavo eleha vayyishkav immah vatteled ben vattikra et-shemo shelomo va-Adonai ahevo
Vayyishlach beyad natan hannavi vayyikra et-shemo yedidyah baavur Adonai
Vayyillachem yoav berabbat bene ammon vayyilkod et-ir hammelucha
Vayyishlach yoav malachim el-david vayyomer nilchamti verabba gam-lachadti et-ir hammayim
Veatta esof et-yeter haam vachane al-hair velachdah pen-elkod ani et-hair venikra shemi aleha
Vayyeesof david et-kal-haam vayyelech rabbata vayyillachem bah vayyilkedah
Vayyikkach et-ateret-malkam meal rosho umishkalah kikkar zahav veeven yekara vattehi al-rosh david ushlal hair hotzi harbe meod
Veet-haam asher-bah hotzi vayyasem bammegera uvacharitze habbarzel uvmagzerot habbarzel veheevir otam bammalben vechen yaase lechol are vene-ammon vayyashav david vechal-haam yerushalam
Vayehi achare-chen ulavshalom ben-david achot yafa ushmah tamar vayyeehaveha amnon ben-david
Vayyetzer leamnon lehitchallot baavur tamar achoto ki vetula hi vayyippale beene amnon laasot lah meuma
Ulamnon rea ushmo yonadav ben-shima achi david veonadav ish chacham meod
Vayyomer lo maddua atta kacha dal ben-hammelech babboker babboker halo taggid li vayyomer lo amnon et-tamar achot avshalom achi ani ohev
Vayyomer lo yehonadav shechav al-mishkavcha vehitchal uva avicha lirotecha veamarta elav tavo na tamar achoti vetavreni lechem veasta leena et-habbirya lemaan asher ere veachalti miyyadah
Vayyishkav amnon vayyitchal vayyavo hammelech liroto vayyomer amnon el-hammelech tavo-na tamar achoti utlabbev leena shette levivot veevre miyyadah
Vayyishlach david el-tamar habbayeta lemor lechi na bet amnon achich vaasi-lo habbirya
Vattelech tamar bet amnon achiha vehu shochev vattikkach et-habbatzek vattalash vattelabbev leenav vattevashshel et-hallevivot
Vattikkach et-hammasret vattitzok lefanav vayemaen leechol vayyomer amnon hotziu chal-ish meala vayyetzu chal-ish mealav
Vayyomer amnon el-tamar havii habbirya hacheder veevre miyyadech vattikkach tamar et-hallevivot asher asata vattave leamnon achiha hechadra
Vattaggesh elav leechol vayyachazek-bah vayyomer lah boi shichvi immi achoti
Vattomer lo al-achi al-teanneni ki lo-yease chen beyisrael al-taase et-hannevala hazzot

Vayyomer yoav laish hammaggid lo vehinne raita umaddua lo-hikkito sham artza veala latet lecha asara chesef vachagora echat
