O-asiti venafshi sheker vechal-davar lo-yikkached min-hammelech veatta tityatztzev minneged
Vayyomer yoav lo-chen ochila lefanecha vayyikkach shelosha shevatim bechappo vayyitkaem belev avshalom odennu cha belev haela
Vayyasobbu asara nearim nose kele yoav vayyakku et-avshalom vayemituhu
Vayyitka yoav bashshofar vayyashav haam mirdof achare yisrael ki-chasach yoav et-haam
Vayyikchu et-avshalom vayyashlichu oto vayyaar el-happachat haggadol vayyatztzivu alav gal-avanim gadol meod vechal-yisrael nasu ish leohalav
Veavshalom lakach vayyatztzev-lo vechayyav et-matztzevet asher beemek-hammelech ki amar en-li ven baavur hazkir shemi vayyikra lammatztzevet al-shemo vayyikkare lah yad avshalom ad hayyom hazze
Vaachimaatz ben-tzadok amar arutza na vaavassera et-hammelech ki-shefato Adonai miyyad oyevav
Vayyomer lo yoav lo ish besora atta hayyom hazze uvissarta beom acher vehayyom hazze lo tevasser al- ken ben-hammelech met
Vayyomer yoav lakkushi lech hagged lammelech asher raita vayyishtachu chushi leoav vayyarotz
Vayyosef od achimaatz ben-tzadok vayyomer el-yoav vihi ma arutza-na gam-ani achare hakkushi vayyomer yoav lamma-ze atta ratz beni ulcha en-besora motzet
Vihi-ma arutz vayyomer lo rutz vayyaratz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et-hakkushi
Vedavid yoshev ben-shene hashshearim vayyelech hatztzofe el-gag hashshaar el-hachoma vayyissa et-enav vayyar vehinne-ish ratz levaddo
Vayyikra hatztzofe vayyagged lammelech vayyomer hammelech im-levaddo besora befiv vayyelech haloch vekarev
Vayyar hatztzofe ish-acher ratz vayyikra hatztzofe el-hashshoer vayyomer hinne-ish ratz levaddo vayyomer hammelech gam-ze mevasser
Vayyomer hatztzofe ani roe et-merutzat harishon kimrutzat achimaatz ben-tzadok vayyomer hammelech ish-tov ze veel-besora tova yavo
Vayyikra achimaatz vayyomer el-hammelech shalom vayyishtachu lammelech leappav artza s vayyomer baruch Adonai elohecha asher siggar et-haanashim asher-nasu et-yadam badoni hammelech
Vayyomer hammelech shalom lannaar leavshalom vayyomer achimaatz raiti hehamon haggadol lishloach et-eved hammelech yoav veet-avdecha velo yadati ma
Vayyomer hammelech sov hityatztzev ko vayyissov vayyaamod
Vehinne hakkushi ba vayyomer hakkushi yitbasser adoni hammelech ki-shefatcha Adonai hayyom miyyad kal-hakkamim alecha
Vayyomer hammelech el-hakkushi hashalom lannaar leavshalom vayyomer hakkushi yihyu channaar oyeve adoni hammelech vechol asher-kamu alecha leraa
Vayyirgaz hammelech vayyaal al-aliyyat hashshaar vayyevke vecho amar belechto beni avshalom beni veni avshalom mi-yitten muti ani tachtecha avshalom beni veni
Vayyuggad leoav hinne hammelech boche vayyitabbel al-avshalom
Vattehi hatteshua bayyom hahu leevel lechal-haam ki-shama haam bayyom hahu lemor neetzav hammelech al-beno
Vayyitgannev haam bayyom hahu lavo hair kaasher yitgannev haam hannichlamim benusam bammilchama
Vehammelech laat et-panav vayyizak hammelech kol gadol beni avshalom avshalom beni veni
Vayyavo yoav el-hammelech habbayit vayyomer hovashta hayyom et-pene chal-avadecha hammalletim et-nafshecha hayyom veet nefesh banecha uvnotecha venefesh nashecha venefesh pilagshecha
Leahava et-sonecha velisno et-ohavecha ki higgadta hayyom ki en lecha sarim vaavadim ki yadati hayyom ki lu avshalom cha vechullanu hayyom metim ki-az yashar beenecha
Veatta kum tze vedabber al-lev avadecha ki va-Adonai nishbati ki-encha yotze im-yalin ish ittecha hallayela veraa lecha zot mikkal-haraa asher-baa alecha minneurecha ad-atta
Vayyakam hammelech vayyeshev bashshaar ulchal-haam higgidu lemor hinne hammelech yoshev bashshaar vayyavo chal-haam lifne hammelech veyisrael nas ish leohalav
Vayehi chal-haam nadon bechal-shivte yisrael lemor hammelech hitztzilanu mikkaf oyevenu vehu milletanu mikkaf pelishtim veatta barach min-haaretz meal avshalom
Veavshalom asher mashachnu alenu met bammilchama veatta lama attem macharishim lehashiv et-hammelech
Vehammelech david shalach el-tzadok veel-evyatar hakkohanim lemor dabberu el-zikne yehuda lemor lamma tihyu acharonim lehashiv et-hammelech el-beto udvar kal-yisrael ba el-hammelech el-beto
Acha attem atzmi uvsari attem velamma tihyu acharonim lehashiv et-hammelech
Velaamasa tomru halo atzmi uvsari atta ko yaase-li elohim vecho yosif im-lo sar-tzava tihye lefana kal-hayyamim tachat yoav
Vayyat et-levav kal-ish-yehuda keish echad vayyishlechu el-hammelech shuv atta vechal-avadecha
Vayyashav hammelech vayyavo ad-hayyarden vihuda ba haggilgala lalechet likrat hammelech lehaavir et-hammelech et-hayyarden
Vayemaher shimi ven-gera ben-hayemini asher mibbachurim vayyered im-ish yehuda likrat hammelech david
Veelef ish immo mibbinyamin vetziva naar bet shaul vachameshet asar banav veesrim avadav itto vetzalchu hayyarden lifne hammelech
Veavra haavara laavir et-bet hammelech velaasot hattov beenav veshimi ven-gera nafal lifne hammelech beavro bayyarden
Vayyomer el-hammelech al-yachashav-li adoni aon veal-tizkor et asher heeva avdecha bayyom asher-yatza adoni-hammelech mirushalam lasum hammelech el-libbo
Ki yada avdecha ki ani chatati vehinne-vati hayyom rishon lechal-bet yosef laredet likrat adoni hammelech
Vayyaan avisha ben-tzeruya vayyomer hatachat zot lo yumat shimi ki killel et-meshiach Adonai
Vayyomer david ma-li velachem bene tzeruya ki-tihyu-li hayyom lesatan hayyom yumat ish beyisrael ki halo yadati ki hayyom ani-melech al-yisrael
Vayyomer hammelech el-shimi lo tamut vayyishshava lo hammelech
Umfivoshet ben-shaul yarad likrat hammelech velo-asa raglav velo-asa sefamo veet-begadav lo chibbes lemin-hayyom lechet hammelech ad-hayyom asher-ba veshalom
Vayehi ki-va yerushalam likrat hammelech vayyomer lo hammelech lamma lo-halachta immi mefivoshet
Vayyomar adoni hammelech avdi rimmani ki-amar avdecha echbesha-li hachamor veerkav aleha veelech et-hammelech ki fisseach avdecha
Vayeraggel beavdecha el-adoni hammelech vadoni hammelech kemalach haelohim vaase hattov beenecha
Ki lo haya kal-bet avi ki im-anshe-mavet ladoni hammelech vattashet et-avdecha beochle shulchanecha uma-yesh-li od tzedaka velizok od el-hammelech
Vayyomer lo hammelech lamma tedabber od devarecha amarti atta vetziva tachleku et-hassade
Vayyomer mefivoshet el-hammelech gam et-hakkol yikkach achare asher-ba adoni hammelech beshalom el-beto
Uvarzilla haggiladi yarad meroglim vayyaavor et-hammelech hayyarden leshallecho hayyarden
Uvarzilla zaken meod ben-shemonim shana vehu-chilkal et-hammelech beshivato vemachanayim ki-ish gadol hu meod
Vayyomer hammelech el-barzilla atta avor itti vechilkalti otcha immadi birushalam
Vayyomer barzilla el-hammelech kamma yeme shene chayya ki-eele et-hammelech yerushalam
Ben-shemonim shana anochi hayyom haeda ben-tov lera im-yitam avdecha et-asher ochal veet-asher eshte im-eshma od bekol sharim vesharot velamma yihye avdecha od lemassa el-adoni hammelech
Kimat yaavor avdecha et-hayyarden et-hammelech velamma yigmeleni hammelech haggemula hazzot
Yashav-na avdecha veamut beiri im kever avi veimmi vehinne avdecha chimham yaavor im-adoni hammelech vaase-lo et asher-tov beenecha
Vayyomer hammelech itti yaavor kimham vaani eese-lo et-hattov beenecha vechol asher-tivchar ala eese-lach
Vayyaavor kal-haam et-hayyarden vehammelech avar vayyishshak hammelech levarzilla vayevarachehu vayyashav limkomo
Vayyaavor hammelech haggilgala vechimhan avar immo vechal-am yehuda heeviru et-hammelech vegam chatzi am yisrael
Vehinne kal-ish yisrael baim el-hammelech vayyomru el-hammelech maddua genavucha achenu ish yehuda vayyaaviru et-hammelech veet-beto et-hayyarden vechal-anshe david immo
Vayyaan kal-ish yehuda al-ish yisrael ki-karov hammelech ela velamma ze chara lecha al-haddavar hazze heachol achalnu min-hammelech im-nisset nissa lanu

Vayyaan ish-yisrael et-ish yehuda vayyomer eser-yadot li vammelech vegam-bedavid ani mimmecha umaddua hekillotani velo-haya devari rishon li lehashiv et-malki vayyikesh devar-ish yehuda middevar ish yisrael
Vesham nikra ish beliyyaal ushmo sheva ben-bichri ish yemini vayyitka bashshofar vayyomer en-lanu chelek bedavid velo nachala-lanu beven-yisha ish leohalav yisrael
Vayyaal kal-ish yisrael meachare david achare sheva ben-bichri veish yehuda davku vemalkam min-hayyarden vead-yerushalam

Vayyavo david el-beto yerushalam vayyikkach hammelech et eser-nashim pilagshim asher hinniach lishmor habbayit vayyittenem bet-mishmeret vayechalkelem vaalehem lo-va vattihyena tzerurot ad-yom mutan almenut chayyut
Vayyomer hammelech el-amasa hazek-li et-ish-yehuda sheloshet yamim veatta po amod
Vayyelech amasa lehazik et-yehuda vayyocher min-hammoed asher yeado
Vayyomer david el-avisha atta yera lanu sheva ben-bichri min-avshalom atta kach et-avde adonecha urdof acharav pen-matza lo arim betzurot vehitztzil enenu
Vayyetzu acharav anshe yoav vehakkereti vehappeleti vechal-haggibborim vayyetzu mirushalam lirdof achare sheva ben-bichri
Hem im-haeven haggedola asher begivon vaamasa ba lifnehem veoav chagur middo levushu vealav chagor cherev metzummedet al-matnav betarah vehu yatza vattippol
Vayyomer yoav laamasa hashalom atta achi vattochez yad-yemin yoav bizkan amasa linshak-lo
Vaamasa lo-nishmar bacherev asher beyad-yoav vayyakkehu vah el-hachomesh vayyishpoch meav artza velo-shana lo vayyamot s veoav vaavisha achiv radaf achare sheva ben-bichri
Veish amad alav minnaare yoav vayyomer mi asher chafetz beoav umi asher-ledavid achare yoav
Vaamasa mitgolel baddam betoch hamsilla vayyar haish ki-amad kal-haam vayyassev et-amasa min-hamsilla hassade vayyashlech alav beged kaasher raa kal-habba alav veamad
Kaasher hoga min-hamsilla avar kal-ish achare yoav lirdof achare sheva ben-bichri
Vayyaavor bechal-shivte yisrael avela uvet maacha vechal-habberim s vayyikkahalu vayyavou af-acharav
Vayyavou vayyatzuru alav beavela bet hammaacha vayyishpechu solla el-hair vattaamod bachel vechal-haam asher et-yoav mashchitim lehappil hachoma
Vattikra ishsha chachama min-hair shimu shimu imru-na el-yoav kerav ad-henna vaadabbera elecha
Vayyikrav eleha vattomer haishsha haatta yoav vayyomer ani vattomer lo shema divre amatecha vayyomer shomea anochi
Vattomer lemor dabber yedabberu varishona lemor shaol yeshaalu beavel vechen hetammu
Anochi shelume emune yisrael atta mevakkesh lehamit ir veem beyisrael lamma tevalla nachalat Adonai
Vayyaan yoav vayyomar chalila chalila li im-avalla veim-ashchit
Lo-chen haddavar ki ish mehar efrayim sheva ben-bichri shemo nasa yado bammelech bedavid tenu-oto levaddo veelcha meal hair vattomer haishsha el-yoav hinne rosho mushlach elecha bead hachoma
Vattavo haishsha el-kal-haam bechachmatah vayyichretu et-rosh sheva ben-bichri vayyashlichu el-yoav vayyitka bashshofar vayyafutzu meal-hair ish leohalav veoav shav yerushalam el-hammelech
Veoav el kal-hatztzava yisrael uvnaya ben-yehoyada hakkereti veal-happeleti
Vaadoram al-hammas vihoshafat ben-achilud hammazkir
Ushva sofer vetzadok veevyatar kohanim
Vegam ira hayyairi haya chohen ledavid
Vayehi raav bime david shalosh shanim shana achare shana vayevakkesh david et-pene Adonai s vayyomer Adonai el-shaul veel-bet haddamim al-asher-hemit et-haggivonim
Vayyikra hammelech laggivonim vayyomer alehem vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma ki im-miyyeter haemori uvne yisrael nishbeu lahem vayevakkesh shaul lehakkotam bekannoto livne-yisrael vihuda
Vayyomer david el-haggivonim ma eese lachem uvamma achapper uvarchu et-nachalat Adonai
Vayyomru lo haggivonim lanu kesef vezahav im-shaul veim-beto veen-lanu ish lehamit beyisrael vayyomer ma-attem omrim eese lachem
Vayyomru el-hammelech haish asher killanu vaasher dimma-lanu nishmadnu mehityatztzev bechal-gevul yisrael
Yntn-yuttan- lanu shiva anashim mibbanav vehokaanum la-Adonai begivat shaul bechir Adonai s vayyomer hammelech ani etten
Vayyachmol hammelech al-mefi-voshet ben-yehonatan ben-shaul al-shevuat Adonai asher benotam ben david uven yehonatan ben-shaul
Vayyikkach hammelech et-shene bene ritzpa vat-ayya asher yalda leshaul et-armoni veet-mefivoshet veet-chameshet bene michal bat-shaul asher yalda leadriel ben-barzilla hammecholati
Vayyittenem beyad haggivonim vayyokium bahar lifne Adonai vayyippelu shevatam yachad vehemma humtu bime katzir barishonim bitchillat ketzir seorim

Vattikkach ritzpa vat-ayya et-hassak vattattehu lah el-hatztzur mittechillat katzir ad nittach-mayim alehem min-hashshamayim velo-natna of hashshamayim lanuach alehem yomam veet-chayyat hassade layela
Vayyuggad ledavid et asher-asta ritzpa vat-ayya pilegesh shaul

Vayyelech david vayyikkach et-atzmot shaul veet-atzmot yehonatan beno meet baale yavesh gilad asher ganvu otam merchov bet-shan asher telaum shm shamma pelishtim beom hakkot pelishtim et-shaul baggilboa
Vayyaal mishsham et-atzmot shaul veet-atzmot yehonatan beno vayyaasfu et-atzmot hammukaim
Vayyikberu et-atzmot-shaul vihonatan-beno beeretz binyamin betzela bekever kish aviv vayyaasu kol asher-tziva hammelech vayyeater elohim laaretz achare-chen
Vattehi-od milchama lappelishtim et-yisrael vayyered david vaavadav immo vayyillachamu et-pelishtim vayyaaf david
Veyishbi benov asher bilide harafa umishkal keno shelosh meot mishkal nechoshet vehu chagur chadasha vayyomer lehakkot et-david
Vayyaazar-lo avisha ben-tzeruya vayyach et-happelishti vayemitehu az nishbeu anshe-david lo lemor lo-tetze od ittanu lammilchama velo techabbe et-ner yisrael
Vayehi achare-chen vattehi-od hammilchama begov im-pelishtim az hikka sibbecha hachushati et-saf asher bilide harafa
Vattehi-od hammilchama begov im-pelishtim vayyach elchanan ben-yare orgim bet hallachmi et galyat haggitti veetz chanito kimnor orgim
Vattehi-od milchama begat vayehi ish madon veetzbeot yadav veetzbeot raglav shesh vashesh esrim vearba mispar vegam-hu yullad leharafa
Vayecharef et-yisrael vayyakkehu yehonatan shima achi david
Et-arbaat elle yulledu leharafa begat vayyippelu veyad-david uvyad avadav
Vayedabber david la-Adonai et-divre hashshira hazzot beom hitztzil Adonai oto mikkaf kal-oyevav umikkaf shaul
Vayyomar Adonai sali umtzudati umfalti-li
Elohe tzuri echese-bo maginni vekeren yishi misgabbi umnusi moshii mechamas toshieni
Mehullal ekra Adonai umeoyeva ivashea
Ki afafuni mishbere-mavet nachale veliyyaal yevaatuni
Chevle sheol sabbuni kiddemuni mokshe-mavet
Batztzar-li ekra Adonai veel-eloha ekra vayyishma mehechalo koli veshaveati beaznav
Vayyitgaash vattirash haaretz mosdot hashshamayim yirgazu vayyitgaashu ki-chara lo
Ala ashan beappo veesh mippiv tochel gechalim baaru mimmennu
Vayyet shamayim vayyerad vaarafel tachat raglav
Vayyirkav al-keruv vayyaof vayyera al-kanfe-ruach
Vayyashet choshech sevivotav sukkot chashrat-mayim ave shechakim
Minnogah negdo baaru gachale-esh
Yarem min-shamayim Adonai veelyon yitten kolo
Vayyishlach chitztzim vayefitzem barak vayyahom
Vayyerau afike yam yiggalu mosdot tevel begaarat Adonai minnishmat ruach appo
Yishlach mimmarom yikkacheni yamsheni mimmayim rabbim
Yatztzileni meoyevi az missona ki amtzu mimmenni
Yekaddemuni beom edi vayehi Adonai mishan li
Vayyotze lammerchav oti yechalletzeni ki-chafetz bi
Yigmeleni Adonai ketzidkati kevor yada yashiv li
Ki shamarti darche Adonai velo rashati meeloha
Ki mishpatav lenegdi vechukkotav lo-asur mimmenna
Vaehye tamim lo vaeshtammera meaoni
Vayyashev Adonai li ketzidkati kevori leneged enav
Im-chasid titchassad im-gibbor tamim tittammam
Im-navar tittavar veim-ikkesh tittappal
Veet-am ani toshia veenecha al-ramim tashpil
Ki-atta neri Adonai va-Adonai yaggiha chashki
Ki vecha arutz gedud beloha adalleg-shur
Hael tamim darko imrat Adonai tzerufa magen hu lechol hachosim bo
Ki mi-el mibbalade Adonai umi tzur mibbalade elohenu
Hael mauzzi chayil vayyatter tamim darki
Meshave ragla kaayyalot veal bamota yaamideni
Melammed yada lammilchama venichat keshet-nechusha zeroota
Vattitten-li magen yishecha vaanotcha tarbeni
Tarchiv tzaadi tachteni velo maadu karsulla
Erdefa oyeva vaashmidem velo ashuv ad-kallotam
Vaachallem vaemchatzem velo yekumun vayyippelu tachat ragla
Vattazreni chayil lammilchama tachria kama tachteni
Veoyeva tatta li oref mesana vaatzmitem
Yishu veen moshia el-Adonai velo anam
Veeshchakem kaafar-aretz ketit-chutzot adikkem erkaem
Vattefalleteni merive ammi tishmereni lerosh goyim am lo-yadati yaavduni
Bene nechar yitkachashu-li lishmoa ozen yishshamu li
Bene nechar yibbolu veyachgeru mimmisgerotam
Cha-Adonai uvaruch tzuri veyarum elohe tzur yishi
Hael hannoten nekamot li umorid ammim tachteni
Umotzii meoyeva umikkama terommeni meish chamasim tatztzileni
Al-ken odcha Adonai baggoyim ulshimcha azammer
Migdol yeshuot malko veose-chesed limshicho ledavid ulzaro ad-olam
Veelle divre david haacharonim neum david ben-yisha unum haggever hukam al meshiach elohe yaakov unim zemirot yisrael
Ruach Adonai dibber-bi umillato al-leshoni
Amar elohe yisrael li dibber tzur yisrael moshel baadam tzaddik moshel yirat elohim
Uchor boker yizrach-shamesh boker lo avot minnogah mimmatar deshe mearetz
Ki-lo-chen beti im-el ki verit olam sam li arucha vakkol ushmura ki-chal-yishi vechal-chefetz ki-lo yatzmiach
Uvliyyaal kekotz munad kullaham ki-lo veyad yikkachu
Veish yigga bahem yimmale varzel veetz chanit uvaesh sarof yissarfu bashshavet
Elle shemot haggibborim asher ledavid yoshev bashshevet tachkemoni rosh hashshalishi hu adino haetzni al-shemone meot chalal befaam echat
Veacharav elazar dodo ben-achochi bishlosha haggibborim im-david becharfam bappelishtim neesfu-sham lammilchama vayyaalu ish yisrael
Hu kam vayyach bappelishtim ad ki-yaga yado vattidbak yado el-hacherev vayyaas Adonai teshua gedola bayyom hahu vehaam yashuvu acharav ach-lefashshet
Veacharav shamma ven-age harari vayyeasfu felishtim lachayya vattehi-sham chelkat hassade melea adashim vehaam nas mippene felishtim
Vayyityatztzev betoch-hachelka vayyatztzileha vayyach et-pelishtim vayyaas Adonai teshua gedola
Vayyerdu shelosha mehashsheloshim rosh vayyavou el-katzir el-david el-mearat adullam vechayyat pelishtim chona beemek refaim
Vedavid az bammetzuda umatztzav pelishtim az bet lachem
Vayyitave david vayyomar mi yashkeni mayim mibbor bet-lechem asher bashshaar
Vayyivkeu sheloshet haggibborim bemachane felishtim vayyishavu-mayim mibbor bet-lechem asher bashshaar vayyisu vayyaviu el-david velo ava lishtotam vayyassech otam la-Adonai
Vayyomer chalila li Adonai measoti zot hadam haanashim haholchim benafshotam velo ava lishtotam elle asu sheloshet haggibborim
Vaavisha achi yoav ben-tzeruya hu rosh hashshelosha vehu orer et-chanito al-shelosh meot chalal velo-shem bashshelosha

I Kings: Vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim vayechassuhu babbegadim velo yicham lo
Vayyomru lo avadav yevakshu ladoni hammelech naara vetula veamda lifne hammelech uthi-lo sochenet veshachva vechekecha vecham ladoni hammelech
Vayevakshu naara yafa bechol gevul yisrael vayyimtzeu et-avishag hashshunammit vayyaviu otah lammelech
Vehannaara yafa ad-meod vattehi lammelech sochenet vatteshartehu vehammelech lo yedaah
Vaadoniyya ven-chaggit mitnasse lemor ani emloch vayyaas lo rechev ufarashim vachamishshim ish ratzim lefanav
Velo-atzavo aviv miyyamav lemor maddua kacha asita vegam-hu tov-toar meod veoto yalda achare avshalom
Vayyihyu devarav im yoav ben-tzeruya veim evyatar hakkohen vayyazeru achare adoniyya
Vetzadok hakkohen uvnayahu ven-yehoyada venatan hannavi veshimi verei vehaggibborim asher ledavid lo hau im-adoniyyahu
Vayyizbach adoniyyahu tzon uvakar umri im even hazzochelet asher-etzel en rogel vayyikra et-kal-echav bene hammelech ulchal-anshe yehuda avde hammelech
Veet-natan hannavi uvnayahu veet-haggibborim veet-shelomo achiv lo kara
Vayyomer natan el-bat-sheva em-shelomo lemor halo shamaatte ki malach adoniyyahu ven-chaggit vaadonenu david lo yada
Veatta lechi iatzech na etza umalleti et-nafshech veet-nefesh benech shelomo
Lechi uvoi el-hammelech david veamarte elav halo-atta adoni hammelech nishbata laamatcha lemor ki-shelomo venech yimloch achara vehu yeshev al-kisi umaddua malach adoniyahu
Hinne odach medabberet sham im-hammelech vaani avo acharayich umilleti et-devarayich
Vattavo vat-sheve el-hammelech hachadra vehammelech zaken meod vaavishag hashshunammit mesharat et-hammelech
Vattikkod bat-sheva vattishtachu lammelech vayyomer hammelech ma-lach
Vattomer lo adoni atta nishbata ba-Adonai elohecha laamatecha ki-shelomo venech yimloch achara vehu yeshev al-kisi
Veatta hinne adoniyya malach veatta adoni hammelech lo yadata
Vayyizbach shor umri-vetzon larov vayyikra lechal-bene hammelech ulevyatar hakkohen ulyoav sar hatztzava velishlomo avdecha lo kara
Veatta adoni hammelech ene chal-yisrael alecha lehaggid lahem mi yeshev al-kisse adoni-hammelech acharav
Vehaya kishchav adoni-hammelech im-avotav vehayiti ani uvni shelomo chattaim
Vehinne odenna medabberet im-hammelech venatan hannavi ba
Vayyaggidu lammelech lemor hinne natan hannavi vayyavo lifne hammelech vayyishtachu lammelech al-appav artza
Vayyomer natan adoni hammelech atta amarta adoniyyahu yimloch achara vehu yeshev al-kisi
Ki yarad hayyom vayyizbach shor umri-vetzon larov vayyikra lechal-bene hammelech ulsare hatztzava ulevyatar hakkohen vehinnam ochlim veshotim lefanav vayyomru yechi hammelech adoniyyahu
Veli ani-avdecha ultzadok hakkohen velivnayahu ven-yehoyada velishlomo avdecha lo kara
Im meet adoni hammelech nihya haddavar hazze velo hodata avdecha mi yeshev al-kisse adoni-hammelech acharav
Vayyaan hammelech david vayyomer kiru-li levat-shava vattavo lifne hammelech vattaamod lifne hammelech
Vayyishshava hammelech vayyomar cha-Adonai asher-pada et-nafshi mikkal-tzara
Ki kaasher nishbati lach ba-Adonai elohe yisrael lemor ki-shelomo venech yimloch achara vehu yeshev al-kisi tachta ki ken eese hayyom hazze
Vattikkod bat-sheva appayim eretz vattishtachu lammelech vattomer yechi adoni hammelech david leolam
Vayyomer hammelech david kiru-li letzadok hakkohen ulnatan hannavi velivnayahu ben-yehoyada vayyavou lifne hammelech
Vayyomer hammelech lahem kechu immachem et-avde adonechem vehirkavtem et-shelomo veni al-happirda asher-li vehoradtem oto el-gichon
Umashach oto sham tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi lemelech al-yisrael utkatem bashshofar vaamartem yechi hammelech shelomo
Vaalitem acharav uva veyashav al-kisi vehu yimloch tachta veoto tziviti lihyot nagid al-yisrael veal-yehuda
Vayyaan benayahu ven-yehoyada et-hammelech vayyomer amen ken yomar Adonai elohe adoni hammelech
Kaasher haya Adonai im-adoni hammelech ken yihye im-shelomo vigaddel et-kiso mikkisse adoni hammelech david
Vayyered tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi uvnayahu ven-yehoyada vehakkereti vehappeleti vayyarkivu et-shelomo al-pirdat hammelech david vayyolichu oto al-gichon
Vayyikkach tzadok hakkohen et-keren hashshemen min-haohel vayyimshach et-shelomo vayyitkeu bashshofar vayyomru kal-haam yechi hammelech shelomo
Vayyaalu chal-haam acharav vehaam mechallelim bachalilim usmechim simcha gedola vattibbaka haaretz bekolam
Vayyishma adoniyyahu vechal-hakkeruim asher itto vehem killu leechol vayyishma yoav et-kol hashshofar vayyomer maddua kol-hakkirya homa
Odennu medabber vehinne yonatan ben-evyatar hakkohen ba vayyomer adoniyyahu bo ki ish chayil atta vetov tevasser
Vayyaan yonatan vayyomer laadoniyyahu aval adonenu hammelech-david himlich et-shelomo
Vayyishlach itto-hammelech et-tzadok hakkohen veet-natan hannavi uvnayahu ben-yehoyada vehakkereti vehappeleti vayyarkivu oto al pirdat hammelech
Vayyimshechu oto tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi lemelech begichon vayyaalu mishsham semechim vattehom hakkirya hu hakkol asher shematem

Vegam-kacha amar hammelech baruch Adonai elohe yisrael asher natan hayyom yoshev al-kisi veena root

Uvnayahu ven-yehoyada al-hatztzava vetzadok veevyatar kohanim
Vaazaryahu ven-natan al-hannitztzavim vezavud ben-natan kohen ree hammelech
Vaachishar al-habbayit vaadoniram ben-avda al-hammas
Velishlomo shenem-asar nitztzavim al-kal-yisrael vechilkelu et-hammelech veet-beto chodesh bashshana yihye haechad lechalkel
Veelle shemotam ben-chur behar efrayim
Ben-deker bemakatz uvshaalvim uvet shamesh veelon bet chanan
Ben-chesed baarubbot lo socho vechal-eretz chefer
Ben-avinadav kal-nafat dor tafat bat-shelomo hayeta lo leishsha
Baana ben-achilud tanach umgiddo vechal-bet shean asher etzel tzartana mittachat leyizreel mibbet shean ad avel mechola ad meever leyakmoam
Ben-gever beramot gilad lo chaot yair ben-menashshe asher baggilad lo chevel argov asher babbashan shishshim arim gedolot choma uvriach nechoshet
Achinadav ben-iddo machanayema
Achimaatz benaftali gam-hu lakach et-basmat bat-shelomo leishsha
Baana ben-chusha beasher uvalot
Yehoshafat ben-paruach beyisashchar
Shimi ven-ela bevinyamin
Gever ben-uri beeretz gilad eretz sichon melech haemori veog melech habbashan untziv echad asher baaretz
Yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher-al-hayyam larov ochlim veshotim usmechim
Ushlomo haya moshel bechal-hammamlachot min-hannahar eretz pelishtim vead gevul mitzrayim maggishim mincha veovdim et-shelomo kal-yeme chayyav
Vayehi lechem-shelomo leom echad sheloshim kor solet veshishshim kor kamach
Asara vakar beriim veesrim bakar rei umea tzon levad meayyal utzvi veyachmur uvarburim avusim
Ki-hu rode bechal-ever hannahar mittifsach vead-azza bechal-malche ever hannahar veshalom haya lo mikkal-avarav missaviv
Vayyeshev yehuda veyisrael lavetach ish tachat gafno vetachat teenato middan vead-beer shava kol yeme shelomo
Vayehi lishlomo arbaim elef urot susim lemerkavo ushnem-asar elef parashim
Vechilkelu hannitztzavim haelle et-hammelech shelomo veet kal-hakkarev el-shulchan hammelech-shelomo ish chadsho lo yeadderu davar
Vehasseorim vehatteven lassusim velarachesh yaviu el-hammakom asher yihye-sham ish kemishpato
Vayyitten elohim chachma lishlomo utvuna harbe meod verochav lev kachol asher al-sefat hayyam
Vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kal-bene-kedem umikkol chachmat mitzrayim
Vayyechkam mikkal-haadam meetan haezrachi veheman vechalkol vedarda bene machol vayehi-shemo vechal-haggoyim saviv
Vayedabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayehi shiro chamishsha vaalef
Vayedabber al-haetzim min-haerez asher ballevanon vead haezov asher yotze bakkir vayedabber al-habbehema veal-haof veal-haremes veal-haddagim
Vayyavou mikkal-haammim lishmoa et chachmat shelomo meet kal-malche haaretz asher shamu et-chachmato
Vayyishlach chiram melech-tzor et-avadav el-shelomo ki shama ki oto mashchu lemelech tachat avihu ki ohev haya chiram ledavid kal-hayyamim
Vayyishlach shelomo el-chiram lemor
Atta yadata et-david avi ki lo yachol livnot bayit leshem Adonai elohav mippene hammilchama asher sevavuhu ad tet-Adonai otam tachat kappot ragla
Veatta heniach Adonai eloha li missaviv en satan veen pega ra
Vehinni omer livnot bayit leshem Adonai eloha kaasher dibber Adonai el-david avi lemor bincha asher etten tachtecha al-kisecha hu-yivne habbayit lishmi
Veatta tzave veyichretu-li arazim min-hallevanon vaavada yihyu im-avadecha uschar avadecha etten lecha kechol asher tomer ki atta yadata ki en banu ish yodea lichrat-etzim katztzidonim
Vayehi kishmoa chiram et-divre shelomo vayyismach meod vayyomer baruch Adonai hayyom asher natan ledavid ben chacham al-haam harav hazze
Vayyishlach chiram el-shelomo lemor shamati et asher-shalachta ela ani eese et-kal-cheftzecha baatze arazim uvaatze veroshim
Avada yoridu min-hallevanon yamma vaani asimem dovrot bayyam ad-hammakom asher-tishlach ela venippatztim sham veatta tissa veatta taase et-cheftzi latet lechem beti
Vayehi chirom noten lishlomo atze arazim vaatze veroshim kal-cheftzo
Ushlomo natan lechiram esrim elef kor chittim makkolet leveto veesrim kor shemen katit ko-yitten shelomo lechiram shana veshana
Va-Adonai natan chachma lishlomo kaasher dibber-lo vayehi shalom ben chiram uven shelomo vayyichretu verit shenehem
Vayyaal hammelech shelomo mas mikkal-yisrael vayehi hammas sheloshim elef ish
Vayyishlachem levanona aseret alafim bachodesh chalifot chodesh yihyu vallevanon shenayim chodashim beveto vaadoniram al-hammas
Vayehi lishlomo shivim elef nose sabbal ushmonim elef chotzev bahar
Levad missare hannitztzavim lishlomo asher al-hammelacha sheloshet alafim ushlosh meot harodim baam haosim bammelacha
Vayetzav hammelech vayyassiu avanim gedolot avanim yekarot leyassed habbayit avne gazit
Vayyifselu bone shelomo uvone chirom vehaggivlim vayyachinu haetzim vehaavanim livnot habbayit
Vayehi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene-yisrael meeretz-mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv hu hachodesh hashsheni limloch shelomo al-yisrael vayyiven habbayit la-Adonai
Vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo la-Adonai shishshim-amma arko veesrim rachbo ushloshim amma komato
Vehaulam al-pene hechal habbayit esrim amma arko al-pene rochav habbayit eser baamma rachbo al-pene habbayit
Vayyaas labbayit challone shekufim atumim
Vayyiven al-kir habbayit yatzia saviv et-kirot habbayit saviv lahechal veladdevir vayyaas tzelaot saviv
Hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rachbah vehattichona shesh baamma rachbah vehashshelishit sheva baamma rachbah ki migraot natan labbayit saviv chutza levilti achoz bekirot-habbayit
Vehabbayit behibbanoto even-shelema massa nivna umakkavot vehaggarzen kal-keli varzel lo-nishma babbayit behibbanoto
Petach hatztzela hattichona el-ketef habbayit hayemanit uvlullim yaalu al-hattichona umin-hattichona el-hashshelishim
Vayyiven et-habbayit vayechallehu vayyispon et-habbayit gevim usderot baarazim
Vayyiven hayyatzia al-kal-habbayit chamesh ammot komato vayyeechoz et-habbayit baatze arazim
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-shelomo lemor
Habbayit hazze asher-atta vone im-telech bechukkota veet-mishpata taase veshamarta et-kal-mitzota lalechet bahem vahakimoti et-devari ittach asher dibbarti el-david avicha
Veshachanti betoch bene yisrael velo eezov et-ammi yisrael
Vayyiven shelomo et-habbayit vayechallehu
Vayyiven et-kirot habbayit mibbayeta betzalot arazim mikkarka habbayit ad-kirot hassippun tzippa etz mibbayit vayetzaf et-karka habbayit betzalot beroshim
Vayyiven et-esrim amma miyyarkete habbayit betzalot arazim min-hakkarka ad-hakkirot vayyiven lo mibbayit lidvir lekodesh hakkodashim
Vearbaim baamma haya habbayit hu hahechal lifna
Veerez el-habbayit penima miklaat pekaim ufture tzitztzim hakkol erez en even nira
Udvir betoch-habbayit mippenima hechin letitten sham et-aron berit Adonai
Velifne haddevir esrim amma orech veesrim amma rochav veesrim amma komato vayetzappehu zahav sagur vayetzaf mizbeach arez
Vayetzaf shelomo et-habbayit mippenima zahav sagur vayeabber berattukot zahav lifne haddevir vayetzappehu zahav
Veet-kal-habbayit tzippa zahav ad-tom kal-habbayit vechal-hammizbeach asher-laddevir tzippa zahav
Vayyaas baddevir shene cheruvim atze-shamen eser ammot komato
Vechamesh ammot kenaf hakkeruv haechat vechamesh ammot kenaf hakkeruv hashshenit eser ammot miktzot kenafav vead-ketzot kenafav
Veeser baamma hakkeruv hashsheni midda achat veketzev echad lishne hakkeruvim
Komat hakkeruv haechad eser baamma vechen hakkeruv hashsheni

Vayyitten et-hakkeruvim betoch habbayit happenimi vayyifresu et-kanfe hakkeruvim vattigga kenaf-haechad bakkir uchnaf hakkeruv hashsheni nogaat bakkir hashsheni vechanfehem el-toch habbayit nogot kanaf el-kanaf
Vayetzaf et-hakkeruvim zahav
Veet kal-kirot habbayit mesav kala pittuche mikleot keruvim vetimorot ufture tzitztzim millifnim velachitzon
Veet-karka habbayit tzippa zahav lifnima velachitzon
Veet petach haddevir asa daltot atze-shamen haayil mezuzot chamishit
Ushte daltot atze-shemen vekala alehem mikleot keruvim vetimorot ufture tzitztzim vetzippa zahav vayyared al-hakkeruvim veal-hattimorot et-hazzahav
Vechen asa lefetach hahechal mezuzot atze-shamen meet reviit
Ushte daltot atze veroshim shene tzelaim haddelet haachat gelilim ushne kelaim haddelet hashshenit gelilim
Vekala keruvim vetimorot ufture tzitztzim vetzippa zahav meyushshar al-hammechukke
Vayyiven et-hechatzer happenimit shelosha ture gazit vetur kerutot arazim
Bashshana harviit yussad bet Adonai beyerach ziv
Uvashshana haachat esre beyerach bul hu hachodesh hashshemini kala habbayit lechal-devarav mishpatav vayyivnehu sheva shanim
Veet-beto bana shelomo shelosh esre shana vayechal et-kal-beto
Vayyiven et-bet yaar hallevanon mea amma arko vachamishshim amma rachbo ushloshim amma komato al arbaa ture ammude arazim uchrutot arazim al-haammudim
Vesafun baerez mimmaal al-hatztzelaot asher al-haammudim arbaim vachamishsha chamishsha asar hattur
Ushkufim shelosha turim umecheza el-mecheza shalosh peamim
Vechal-happetachim vehammezuzot revuim shakef umul mecheza el-mecheza shalosh peamim
Veet ulam haammudim asa chamishshim amma arko ushloshim amma rachbo veulam al-penehem veammudim veav al-penehem
Veulam hakkisse asher yishpat-sham ulam hammishpat asa vesafun baerez mehakkarka ad-hakkarka
Uveto asher-yeshev sham chatzer haacheret mibbet laulam kammaase hazze haya uvayit yaase levat-paro asher lakach shelomo kaulam hazze
Kal-elle avanim yekarot kemiddot gazit megorarot bammegera mibbayit umichutz umimmassad ad-hattefachot umichutz ad-hechatzer haggedola
Umyussad avanim yekarot avanim gedolot avne eser ammot veavne shemone ammot
Umilmala avanim yekarot kemiddot gazit vaarez
Vechatzer haggedola saviv shelosha turim gazit vetur kerutot arazim velachatzar bet-Adonai happenimit ululam habbayit
Vayyishlach hammelech shelomo vayyikkach et-chiram mitztzor

Ben-ishsha almana hu mimmatte naftali veaviv ish-tzori choresh nechoshet vayyimmale et-hachachma veet-hattevuna veet-haddaat laasot kal-melacha bannechoshet vayyavo el-hammelech shelomo vayyaas et-kal-melachto
Vayyatzar et-shene haammudim nechoshet shemone esre amma komat haammud haechad vechut shettem-esre amma yasov et-haammud hashsheni
Ushte chotarot asa latet al-rashe haammudim mutzak nechoshet chamesh ammot komat hakkoteret haechat vechamesh ammot komat hakkoteret hashshenit
Sevachim maase sevacha gedilim maase sharsherot lakkotarot asher al-rosh haammudim shiva lakkoteret haechat veshiva lakkoteret hashshenit
Vayyaas et-haammudim ushne turim saviv al-hassevacha haechat lechassot et-hakkotarot asher al-rosh harimmonim vechen asa lakkoteret hashshenit
Vechotarot asher al-rosh haammudim maase shushan baulam arba ammot
Vechotarot al-shene haammudim gam-mimmaal milleummat habbeten asher leever hassevacha veharimmonim matayim turim saviv al hakkoteret hashshenit
Vayyakem et-haammudim leulam hahechal vayyakem et-haammud hayemani vayyikra et-shemo yachin vayyakem et-haammud hassemali vayyikra et-shemo boaz
Veal rosh haammudim maase shoshan vattittom melechet haammudim
Vayyaas et-hayyam mutzak eser baamma missefato ad-sefato agol saviv vechamesh baamma komato vekav sheloshim baamma yasov oto saviv
Ufkaim mittachat lisfato saviv sovvim oto eser baamma makkifim et-hayyam saviv shene turim happekaim yetzukim bitzukato
Omed al-shene asar bakar shelosha fonim tzafona ushlosha fonim yamma ushlosha ponim negba ushlosha ponim mizracha vehayyam alehem milmala vechal-achorehem bayeta
Veavyo tefach usfato kemaase sefat-kos perach shoshan alpayim bat yachil
Vayyaas et-hammechonot eser nechoshet arba baamma orech hammechona haechat vearba baamma rachbah veshalosh baamma komatah
Veze maase hammechona misgerot lahem umisgerot ben hashlabbim
Veal-hammisgerot asher ben hashlabbim araot bakar uchruvim veal-hashlabbim ken mimmaal umittachat laaraot velabbakar loyot maase morad
Vearbaa ofanne nechoshet lammechona haachat vesarne nechoshet vearbaa faamotav ketefot lahem mittachat lakkiyyor hakketefot yetzukot meever ish loyot
Ufihu mibbet lakkoteret vamala baamma ufiha agol maase-chen amma vachatzi haamma vegam-al-piha miklaot umisgerotehem merubbaot lo agullot
Vearbaat haofannim lemittachat lammisgerot vidot haofannim bammechona vekomat haofan haechad amma vachatzi haamma
Umaase haofannim kemaase ofan hammerkava yedotam vegabbehem vechishshukehem vechishshurehem hakkol mutzak
Vearba ketefot el arba pinnot hammechona haechat min-hammechona ketefeha
Uvrosh hammechona chatzi haamma koma agol saviv veal rosh hammechona yedoteha umisgeroteha mimmenna
Vayefattach al-halluchot yedoteha veal misgeroteha keruvim araot vetimorot kemaar-ish veloyot saviv
Kazot asa et eser hammechonot mutzak echad midda achat ketzev echad lechullahna
Vayyaas asara chiyyorot nechoshet arbaim bat yachil hakkiyyor haechad arba baamma hakkiyyor haechad kiyyor echad al-hammechona haachat leeser hammechonot
Vayyitten et-hammechonot chamesh al-ketef habbayit miyyamin vechamesh al-ketef habbayit missemolo veet-hayyam natan mikketef habbayit hayemanit kedma mimmul negev
Vayyaas chirom et-hakkiyyorot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizrakot vayechal chiram laasot et-kal-hammelacha asher asa lammelech shelomo bet Adonai
Ammudim shenayim vegullot hakkotarot asher-al-rosh haammudim shettayim vehassevachot shettayim lechassot et-shette gullot hakkotarot asher al-rosh haammudim
Veet-harimmonim arba meot lishte hassevachot shene-turim rimmonim lassevacha haechat lechassot et-shette gullot hakkotarot asher al-pene haammudim
Veet-hammechonot aser veet-hakkiyyorot asara al-hammechonot
Veet-hayyam haechad veet-habbakar shenem-asar tachat hayyam
Veet-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hammizrakot veet kal-hakkelim haelle asher asa chiram lammelech shelomo bet Adonai nechoshet memorat
Bechikkar hayyarden yetzakam hammelech bemaave haadama ben sukkot uven tzartan
Vayyannach shelomo et-kal-hakkelim merov meod meod lo nechkar mishkal hannechoshet
Vayyaas shelomo et kal-hakkelim asher bet Adonai et mizbach hazzahav veet-hashshulchan asher alav lechem happanim zahav
Veet-hammenorot chamesh miyyamin vechamesh missemol lifne haddevir zahav sagur vehapperach vehannerot vehammelkachayim zahav
Vehassippot vehamzammerot vehammizrakot vehakkappot vehammachtot zahav sagur vehappotot ledaltot habbayit happenimi lekodesh hakkodashim ledalte habbayit lahechal zahav
Vattishlam kal-hammelacha asher asa hammelech shelomo bet Adonai vayyave shelomo et-kadshe david aviv et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav veet-hakkelim natan beotzrot bet Adonai
Az yakhel shelomo et-zikne yisrael et-kal-rashe hammattot nesie haavot livne yisrael el-hammelech shelomo yerushalam lehaalot et-aron berit-Adonai meir david hi tziyyon
Vayyikkahalu el-hammelech shelomo kal-ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag hu hachodesh hashshevii
Vayyavou kol zikne yisrael vayyisu hakkohanim et-haaron
Vayyaalu et-aron Adonai veet-ohel moed veet-kal-kele hakkodesh asher baohel vayyaalu otam hakkohanim vehalviyyim
Vehammelech shelomo vechal-adat yisrael hannoadim alav itto lifne haaron mezabbechim tzon uvakar asher lo-yissafru velo yimmanu merov
Vayyaviu hakkohanim et-aron berit-Adonai el-mekomo el-devir habbayit el-kodesh hakkodashim el-tachat kanfe hakkeruvim
Ki hakkeruvim porsim kenafayim el-mekom haaron vayyasokku hakkeruvim al-haaron veal-baddav milmala
Vayyaarichu habbaddim vayyerau rashe habbaddim min-hakkodesh al-pene haddevir velo yerau hachutza vayyihyu sham ad hayyom hazze
En baaron rak shene luchot haavanim asher hinniach sham moshe bechorev asher karat Adonai im-bene yisrael betzetam meeretz mitzrayim
Vayehi betzet hakkohanim min-hakkodesh veheanan male et-bet Adonai
Velo-yachlu hakkohanim laamod lesharet mippene heanan ki-male chevod-Adonai et-bet Adonai
Az amar shelomo Adonai amar lishkon baarafel
Bano vaniti bet zevul lach machon leshivtecha olamim
Vayyassev hammelech et-panav vayevarech et kal-kehal yisrael vechal-kehal yisrael omed
Vayyomer baruch Adonai elohe yisrael asher dibber befiv et david avi uvyado mille lemor
Min-hayyom asher hotzeti et-ammi et-yisrael mimmitzrayim lo-vacharti veir mikkol shivte yisrael livnot bayit lihyot shemi sham vaevchar bedavid lihyot al-ammi yisrael
Vayehi im-levav david avi livnot bayit leshem Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-david avi yaan asher haya im-levavcha livnot bayit lishmi hetivota ki haya im-levavecha
Rak atta lo tivne habbayit ki im-bincha hayyotze mechalatzecha hu-yivne habbayit lishmi
Vayyakem Adonai et-devaro asher dibber vaakum tachat david avi vaeshev al-kisse yisrael kaasher dibber Adonai vaevne habbayit leshem Adonai elohe yisrael
Vaasim sham makom laaron asher-sham berit Adonai asher karat im-avotenu behotzio otam meeretz mitzrayim
Vayyaamod shelomo lifne mizbach Adonai neged kal-kehal yisrael vayyifros kappav hashshamayim
Vayyomar Adonai elohe yisrael en-kamocha elohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal-haaretz mittachat shomer habberit vehachesed laavadecha haholchim lefanecha bechal-libbam
Asher shamarta leavdecha david avi et asher-dibbarta lo vattedabber beficha uvyadcha milleta kayyom hazze

Veatta Adonai elohe yisrael shemor leavdecha david avi et asher dibbarta lo lemor lo-yikkaret lecha ish millefana yoshev al-kisse yisrael rak im-yishmeru vanecha et-darkam lalechet lefana kaasher halachta lefana
Veatta elohe yisrael yeamen na devarcha asher dibbarta leavdecha david avi
Ki haumnam yeshev elohim al-haaretz hinne hashshamayim ushme hashshamayim lo yechalkelucha af ki-habbayit hazze asher baniti
Ufanita el-tefillat avdecha veel-techinnato Adonai eloha lishmoa el-harinna veel-hattefilla asher avdecha mitpallel lefanecha hayyom
Lihyot enecha fetuchot el-habbayit hazze layela vaom el-hammakom asher amarta yihye shemi sham lishmoa el-hattefilla asher yitpallel avdecha el-hammakom hazze
Veshamata el-techinnat avdecha veammecha yisrael asher yitpallu el-hammakom hazze veatta tishma el-mekom shivtecha el-hashshamayim veshamata vesalachta
Et asher yecheta ish lereehu venasha-vo ala lehaaloto uva ala lifne mizbachacha babbayit hazze
Veatta tishma hashshamayim veasita veshafatta et-avadecha leharshia rasha latet darko berosho ulhatzdik tzaddik latet lo ketzidkato
Behinnagef ammecha yisrael lifne oyev asher yechetu-lach veshavu elecha vehodu et-shemecha vehitpallu vehitchannenu elecha babbayit hazze
Veatta tishma hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat ammecha yisrael vahashevotam el-haadama asher natatta laavotam
Beheatzer shamayim velo-yihye matar ki yechetu-lach vehitpallu el-hammakom hazze vehodu et-shemecha umechattatam yeshuvun ki taanem
Veatta tishma hashshamayim vesalachta lechattat avadecha veammecha yisrael ki torem et-hadderech hattova asher yelchu-vah venatatta matar al-artzecha asher-natatta leammecha lenachala
Raav ki-yihye vaaretz dever ki-yihye shiddafon yerakon arbe chasil ki yihye ki yatzar-lo oyevo beeretz shearav kal-nega kal-machala
Kal-tefilla chal-techinna asher tihye lechal-haadam lechol ammecha yisrael asher yedun ish nega levavo ufaras kappav el-habbayit hazze
Veatta tishma hashshamayim mechon shivtecha vesalachta veasita venatatta laish kechal-derachav asher teda et-levavo ki-atta yadata levaddecha et-levav kal-bene haadam
Lemaan yiraucha kal-hayyamim asher-hem chayyim al-pene haadama asher natatta laavotenu
Vegam el-hannachri asher lo-meammecha yisrael hu uva meeretz rechoka lemaan shemecha
Ki yishmeun et-shimcha haggadol veet-yadcha hachazaka uzroacha hannetuya uva vehitpallel el-habbayit hazze

Atta tishma hashshamayim mechon shivtecha veasita kechol asher-yikra elecha hannachri lemaan yedun kal-amme haaretz et-shemecha leyira otcha keammecha yisrael veladaat ki-shimcha nikra al-habbayit hazze asher baniti
Ki-yetze ammecha lammilchama al-oyevo badderech asher tishlachem vehitpallu el-Adonai derech hair asher bacharta bah vehabbayit asher-baniti lishmecha
Veshamata hashshamayim et-tefillatam veet-techinnatam veasita mishpatam
Ki yechetu-lach ki en adam asher lo-yecheta veanafta vam untattam lifne oyev veshavum shovehem el-eretz haoyev rechoka o kerova
Veheshivu el-libbam baaretz asher nishbu-sham veshavu vehitchannenu elecha beeretz shovehem lemor chatanu veheevinu rashanu
Veshavu elecha bechal-levavam uvchal-nafsham beeretz oyevehem asher-shavu otam vehitpallu elecha derech artzam asher natatta laavotam hair asher bacharta vehabbayit baniti lishmecha
Veshamata hashshamayim mechon shivtecha et-tefillatam veet-techinnatam veasita mishpatam
Vesalachta leammecha asher chatu-lach ulchal-pishehem asher pashu-vach untattam lerachamim lifne shovehem verichamum
Ki-ammecha venachalatcha hem asher hotzeta mimmitzrayim mittoch kur habbarzel
Lihyot enecha fetuchot el-techinnat avdecha veel-techinnat ammecha yisrael lishmoa alehem bechol karam elecha
Ki-atta hivdaltam lecha lenachala mikkol amme haaretz kaasher dibbarta beyad moshe avdecha behotziacha et-avotenu mimmitzrayim adona Adonai
Vayehi kechallot shelomo lehitpallel el-Adonai et kal-hattefilla vehattechinna hazzot kam millifne mizbach Adonai mikkeroa al-birkav vechappav perusot hashshamayim
Vayyamod vayevarech et kal-kehal yisrael kol gadol lemor
Baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael kechol asher dibber lo-nafal davar echad mikkol devaro hattov asher dibber beyad moshe avdo
Yehi Adonai elohenu immanu kaasher haya im-avotenu al-yaazvenu veal-yitteshenu
Lehattot levavenu elav lalechet bechal-derachav velishmor mitzotav vechukkav umishpatav asher tziva et-avotenu
Veyihyu devara elle asher hitchannanti lifne Adonai kerovim el-Adonai elohenu yomam valayela laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael devar-yom beomo
Lemaan daat kal-amme haaretz ki Adonai hu haelohim en od
Vehaya levavchem shalem im Adonai elohenu lalechet bechukkav velishmor mitzotav kayyom hazze
Vehammelech vechal-yisrael immo zovchim zevach lifne Adonai
Vayyizbach shelomo et zevach hashshelamim asher zavach la-Adonai bakar esrim ushnayim elef vetzon mea veesrim alef vayyachnechu et-bet Adonai hammelech vechal-bene yisrael

Bayyom hahu kiddash hammelech et-toch hechatzer asher lifne vet-Adonai ki-asa sham et-haola veet-hammincha veet chelve hashshelamim ki-mizbach hannechoshet asher lifne Adonai katon mehachil et-haola veet-hammincha veet chelve hashshelamim
Vayyaas shelomo vaet-hahi et-hechag vechal-yisrael immo kahal gadol millevo chamat ad-nachal mitzrayim lifne Adonai elohenu shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom
Bayyom hashshemini shillach et-haam vayevarachu et-hammelech vayyelchu leaholehem semechim vetove lev al kal-hattova asher asa Adonai ledavid avdo ulyisrael ammo
Vayehi kechallot shelomo livnot et-bet-Adonai veet-bet hammelech veet kal-cheshek shelomo asher chafetz laasot
Vayyera Adonai el-shelomo shenit kaasher nira elav begivon
Vayyomer Adonai elav shamati et-tefillatcha veet-techinnatcha asher hitchannanta lefana hikdashti et-habbayit hazze asher banita lasum-shemi sham ad-olam vehau ena velibbi sham kal-hayyamim
Veatta im-telech lefana kaasher halach david avicha betam-levav uvyosher laasot kechol asher tziviticha chukka umishpata tishmor
Vahakimoti et-kisse mamlachtecha al-yisrael leolam kaasher dibbarti al-david avicha lemor lo-yikkaret lecha ish meal kisse yisrael
Im-shov teshuvun attem uvnechem meachara velo tishmeru mitzota chukkota asher natatti lifnechem vahalachtem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem
Vehichratti et-yisrael meal pene haadama asher natatti lahem veet-habbayit asher hikdashti lishmi ashallach meal pana vehaya yisrael lemashal velishnina bechal-haammim
Vehabbayit hazze yihye elyon kal-over alav yishshom vesharak veamru al-me asa Adonai kacha laaretz hazzot velabbayit hazze
Veamru al asher azvu et-Adonai elohehem asher hotzi et-avotam meeretz mitzrayim vayyachaziku belohim acherim vayyishtachau lahem vayyaavdum al-ken hevi Adonai alehem et kal-haraa hazzot
Vayehi miktze esrim shana asher-bana shelomo et-shene habbattim et-bet Adonai veet-bet hammelech
Chiram melech-tzor nissa et-shelomo baatze arazim uvaatze veroshim uvazzahav lechal-cheftzo az yitten hammelech shelomo lechiram esrim ir beeretz haggalil
Vayyetze chiram mitztzor lirot et-hearim asher natan-lo shelomo velo yashru beenav
Vayyomer ma hearim haelle asher-natatta li achi vayyikra lahem eretz kavul ad hayyom hazze
Vayyishlach chiram lammelech mea veesrim kikkar zahav
Veze devar-hammas asher-heela hammelech shelomo livnot et-bet Adonai veet-beto veet-hammillo veet chomat yerushalam veet-chatzor veet-megiddo veet-gazer
Paro melech-mitzrayim ala vayyilkod et-gezer vayyisrefah baesh veet-hakkenaani hayyoshev bair harag vayyittenah shilluchim levitto eshet shelomo
Vayyiven shelomo et-gazer veet-bet choron tachton
Veet-baalat tadmor bammidbar baaretz
Veet kal-are hammiskenot asher hau lishlomo veet are harechev veet are happarashim veet cheshek shelomo asher chashak livnot birushalam uvallevanon uvchol eretz memshalto
Kal-haam hannotar min-haemori hachitti happerizzi hachivi vehayevusi asher lo-mibbene yisrael hemma
Benehem asher notru acharehem baaretz asher lo-yachlu bene yisrael lehacharimam vayyaalem shelomo lemas-oved ad hayyom hazze
Umibbene yisrael lo-natan shelomo aved ki-hem anshe hammilchama vaavadav vesarav veshalishav vesare richbo ufarashav
Elle sare hannitztzavim asher al-hammelacha lishlomo chamishshim vachamesh meot harodim baam haosim bammelacha
Ach bat-paro alta meir david el-betah asher bana-lah az bana et-hammillo
Veheela shelomo shalosh peamim bashshana olot ushlamim al-hammizbeach asher bana la-Adonai vehakter itto asher lifne Adonai veshillam et-habbayit
Vaoni asa hammelech shelomo beetzyon-gever asher et-elot al-sefat yam-suf beeretz edom
Vayyishlach chiram baoni et-avadav anshe oniyyot yode hayyam im avde shelomo
Vayyavou ofira vayyikchu mishsham zahav arba-meot veesrim kikkar vayyaviu el-hammelech shelomo
Umalkat-sheva shomaat et-shema shelomo leshem Adonai vattavo lenassoto bechidot
Vattavo yerushalama bechayil kaved meod gemallim nosim besamim vezahav rav-meod veeven yekara vattavo el-shelomo vattedabber elav et kal-asher haya im-levavah
Vayyagged-lah shelomo et-kal-devareha lo-haya davar nelam min-hammelech asher lo higgid lah
Vattere malkat-sheva et kal-chachmat shelomo vehabbayit asher bana
Umaachal shulchano umoshav avadav umaamad meshartav umalbushehem umashkav veolato asher yaale bet Adonai velo-haya vah od ruach
Vattomer el-hammelech emet haya haddavar asher shamati beartzi al-devarecha veal-chachmatecha
Velo-heemanti laddevarim ad asher-bati vattirena ena vehinne lo-huggad-li hachetzi hosafta chachma vatov el-hashshemua asher shamati
Ashre anashecha ashre avadecha elle haomdim lefanecha tamid hashshomim et-chachmatecha
Yehi Adonai elohecha baruch asher chafetz becha letittecha al-kisse yisrael beahavat Adonai et-yisrael leolam vayesimcha lemelech laasot mishpat utzdaka
Vattitten lammelech mea veesrim kikkar zahav uvsamim harbe meod veeven yekara lo-va chabbosem hahu od larov asher-natna malkat-sheva lammelech shelomo
Vegam oni chiram asher-nasa zahav meofir hevi meofir atze almuggim harbe meod veeven yekara
Vayyaas hammelech et-atze haalmuggim misad levet-Adonai ulvet hammelech vechinnorot unvalim lashsharim lo va-chen atze almuggim velo nira ad hayyom hazze
Vehammelech shelomo natan lemalkat-sheva et-kal-cheftzah asher shaala millevad asher natan-lah keyad hammelech shelomo vattefen vattelech leartzah hi vaavadeha
Vayehi mishkal hazzahav asher-ba lishlomo beshana echat shesh meot shishshim vashesh kikkar zahav
Levad meanshe hattarim umischar harochlim vechal-malche haerev ufachot haaretz
Vayyaas hammelech shelomo matayim tzinna zahav shachut shesh-meot zahav yaale al-hatztzinna haechat
Ushlosh-meot maginnim zahav shachut sheloshet manim zahav yaale al-hammagen haechat vayyittenem hammelech bet yaar hallevanon
Vayyaas hammelech kisse-shen gadol vayetzappehu zahav mufaz
Shesh maalot lakkisse verosh-agol lakkisse meacharav veyadot mizze umizze el-mekom hashshavet ushnayim araot omdim etzel hayyadot
Ushnem asar arayim omdim sham al-shesh hammaalot mizze umizze lo-naasa chen lechal-mamlachot
Vechol kele mashke hammelech shelomo zahav vechol kele bet-yaar hallevanon zahav sagur en kesef lo nechshav bime shelomo limuma
Ki oni tarshish lammelech bayyam im oni chiram achat leshalosh shanim tavo oni tarshish noset zahav vachesef shenhabbim vekofim vetukkiyyim
Vayyigdal hammelech shelomo mikkol malche haaretz leosher ulchachma
Vechal-haaretz mevakshim et-pene shelomo lishmoa et-chachmato asher-natan elohim belibbo
Vehemma meviim ish minchato kele chesef uchle zahav uslamot veneshek uvsamim susim ufradim devar-shana beshana
Vayyeesof shelomo rechev ufarashim vayehi-lo elef vearba-meot rechev ushnem-asar elef parashim vayyanchem beare harechev veim-hammelech birushalam
Vayyitten hammelech et-hakkesef birushalam kaavanim veet haarazim natan kashshikmim asher-bashshefela larov
Umotza hassusim asher lishlomo mimmitzrayim umikve sochare hammelech yikchu mikve bimchir
Vattaale vattetze merkava mimmitzrayim beshesh meot kesef vesus bachamishshim umea vechen lechal-malche hachittim ulmalche aram beyadam yotziu
Vehammelech shelomo ahav nashim nachriyyot rabbot veet-bat-paro moaviyyot ammoniyyot adomiyyot tzedniyyot chittiyyot
Min-haggoyim asher amar-Adonai el-bene yisrael lo-tavou vahem vehem lo-yavou vachem achen yattu et-levavchem achare elohehem bahem davak shelomo leahava
Vayehi-lo nashim sarot sheva meot ufilagshim shelosh meot vayyattu nashav et-libbo
Vayehi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et-levavo achare elohim acherim velo-haya levavo shalem im-Adonai elohav kilvav david aviv
Vayyelech shelomo achare ashtoret elohe tzidonim veachare milkom shikkutz ammonim
Vayyaas shelomo hara beene Adonai velo mille achare Adonai kedavid aviv
Az yivne shelomo bama lichmosh shikkutz moav bahar asher al-pene yerushalam ulmolech shikkutz bene ammon
Vechen asa lechal-nashav hannachriyyot maktirot umzabbechot lelohehen
Vayyitannaf Adonai bishlomo ki-nata levavo meim Adonai elohe yisrael hannira elav paamayim
Vetziva elav al-haddavar hazze levilti-lechet achare elohim acherim velo shamar et asher-tziva Adonai
Vayyomer Adonai lishlomo yaan asher hayeta-zot immach velo shamarta beriti vechukkota asher tziviti alecha karoa ekra et-hammamlacha mealecha untattiha leavdecha
Ach-beyamecha lo eesenna lemaan david avicha miyyad bincha ekraenna
Rak et-kal-hammamlacha lo ekra shevet echad etten livnecha lemaan david avdi ulmaan yerushalam asher bacharti
Vayyakem Adonai satan lishlomo et hadad haadomi mizzera hammelech hu beedom
Vayehi bihyot david et-edom baalot yoav sar hatztzava lekabber et-hachalalim vayyach kal-zachar beedom
Ki sheshet chodashim yashav-sham yoav vechal-yisrael ad-hichrit kal-zachar beedom
Vayyivrach adad hu vaanashim adomiyyim meavde aviv itto lavo mitzrayim vahadad naar katan
Vayyakumu mimmidyan vayyavou paran vayyikchu anashim immam mipparan vayyavou mitzrayim el-paro melech-mitzrayim vayyitten-lo vayit velechem amar lo veeretz natan lo
Vayyimtza hadad chen beene faro meod vayyitten-lo ishsha et-achot ishto achot tachpenes haggevira
Vatteled lo achot tachpenes et genuvat beno vattigmelehu tachpenes betoch bet paro vayehi genuvat bet paro betoch bene faro
Vahadad shama bemitzrayim ki-shachav david im-avotav vechi-met yoav sar-hatztzava vayyomer hadad el-paro shallecheni veelech el-artzi
Vayyomer lo faro ki ma-atta chaser immi vehinnecha mevakkesh lalechet el-artzecha vayyomer lo ki shalleach teshallecheni
Vayyakem elohim lo satan et-rezon ben-elyada asher barach meet hadadezer melech-tzova adonav
Vayyikbotz alav anashim vayehi sar-gedud baharog david otam vayyelchu dammesek vayyeshvu vah vayyimlechu bedammasek
Vayehi satan leyisrael kal-yeme shelomo veet-haraa asher hadad vayyakatz beyisrael vayyimloch al-aram
Veyaravam ben-nevat efrati min-hatztzereda veshem immo tzerua ishsha almana eved lishlomo vayyarem yad bammelech
Veze haddavar asher-herim yad bammelech shelomo bana et-hammillo sagar et-peretz ir david aviv
Vehaish yaravam gibbor chayil vayyar shelomo et-hannaar ki-ose melacha hu vayyafked oto lechal-sevel bet yosef
Vayehi baet hahi veyaravam yatza mirushalam vayyimtza oto achiyya hashshiloni hannavi badderech vehu mitkasse besalma chadasha ushnehem levaddam bassade
Vayyitpos achiyya bassalma hachadasha asher alav vayyikraeha shenem asar keraim
Vayyomer leyaravam kach-lecha asara keraim ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael hinni korea et-hammamlacha miyyad shelomo venatatti lecha et asara hashshevatim
Vehashshevet haechad yihye-lo lemaan avdi david ulmaan yerushalam hair asher bacharti vah mikkol shivte yisrael
Yaan asher azavuni vayyishtachau leashtoret elohe tzidonin lichmosh elohe moav ulmilkom elohe vene-ammon velo-halchu vidracha laasot hayyashar beena vechukkota umishpata kedavid aviv
Velo-ekkach et-kal-hammamlacha miyyado ki nasi ashitennu kol yeme chayyav lemaan david avdi asher bacharti oto asher shamar mitzota vechukkota
Velakachti hammelucha miyyad beno untattiha lecha et aseret hashshevatim
Velivno etten shevet-echad lemaan heot-nir ledavid-avdi kal-hayyamim lefana birushalam hair asher bacharti li lasum shemi sham
Veotcha ekkach umalachta bechol asher-teave nafshecha vehayita melech al-yisrael

Vehaya im-tishma et-kal-asher atzavecha vehalachta vidracha veasita hayyashar beena lishmor chukkota umitzota kaasher asa david avdi vehayiti immach uvaniti lecha vayit-neeman kaasher baniti ledavid venatatti lecha et-yisrael
Vaanne et-zera david lemaan zot ach lo chal-hayyamim
Vayevakkesh shelomo lehamit et-yaravam vayyakam yaravam vayyivrach mitzrayim el-shishak melech-mitzrayim vayehi vemitzrayim ad-mot shelomo
Veyeter divre shelomo vechal-asher asa vechachmato halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre shelomo
Vehayyamim asher malach shelomo virushalam al-kal-yisrael arbaim shana
Vayyishkav shelomo im-avotav vayyikkaver beir david aviv vayyimloch rechavam beno tachtav
Vayyelech rechavam shechem ki shechem ba chal-yisrael lehamlich oto
Vayehi kishmoa yaravam ben-nevat vehu odennu vemitzrayim asher barach mippene hammelech shelomo vayyeshev yaravam bemitzrayim
Vayyishlechu vayyikreu-lo vayyavo yaravam vechal-kehal yisrael vayedabberu el-rechavam lemor
Avicha hiksha et-ullenu veatta atta hakel meavodat avicha hakkasha umeullo hakkaved asher-natan alenu venaavdekka
Vayyomer alehem lechu od shelosha yamim veshuvu ela vayyelchu haam
Vayyivaatz hammelech rechavam et-hazzekenim asher-hau omdim et-pene shelomo aviv bihyoto cha lemor ech attem noatzim lehashiv et-haam-hazze davar
Vayedabberu elav lemor im-hayyom tihye-eved laam hazze vaavadtam vaanitam vedibbarta alehem devarim tovim vehau lecha avadim kal-hayyamim
Vayyaazov et-atzat hazzekenim asher yeatzuhu vayyivaatz et-hayeladim asher gadlu itto asher haomdim lefanav
Vayyomer alehem ma attem noatzim venashiv davar et-haam hazze asher dibberu ela lemor hakel min-haol asher-natan avicha alenu
Vayedabberu elav hayeladim asher gadlu itto lemor ko-tomar laam hazze asher dibberu elecha lemor avicha hichbid et-ullenu veatta hakel mealenu ko tedabber alehem katanni ava mimmatne avi
Veatta avi hemis alechem ol kaved vaani osif al-ullechem avi yissar etchem bashshotim vaani ayasser etchem baakrabbim
Vayyavo yaravam vechal-haam el-rechavam bayyom hashshelishi kaasher dibber hammelech lemor shuvu ela bayyom hashshelishi
Vayyaan hammelech et-haam kasha vayyaazov et-atzat hazzekenim asher yeatzuhu
Vayedabber alehem kaatzat hayeladim lemor avi hichbid et-ullechem vaani osif al-ullechem avi yissar etchem bashshotim vaani ayasser etchem baakrabbim
Velo-shama hammelech el-haam ki-hayeta sibba meim Adonai lemaan hakim et-devaro asher dibber Adonai beyad achiyya hashshiloni el-yaravam ben-nevat

Vayyar kal-yisrael ki lo-shama hammelech alehem vayyashivu haam et-hammelech davar lemor ma-lanu chelek bedavid velo-nachala beven-yisha leohalecha yisrael atta ree vetcha david vayyelech yisrael leohalav
Uvne yisrael hayyoshvim beare yehuda vayyimloch alehem rechavam
Vayyishlach hammelech rechavam et-adoram asher al-hammas vayyirgemu chal-yisrael bo even vayyamot vehammelech rechavam hitammetz laalot bammerkava lanus yerushalam
Vayyifsheu yisrael bevet david ad hayyom hazze
Vayehi kishmoa kal-yisrael ki-shav yaravam vayyishlechu vayyikreu oto el-haeda vayyamlichu oto al-kal-yisrael lo haya achare vet-david zulati shevet-yehuda levaddo
Vayyavo rechavam yerushalam vayyakhel et-kal-bet yehuda veet-shevet binyamin mea ushmonim elef bachur ose milchama lehillachem im-bet yisrael lehashiv et-hammelucha lirchavam ben-shelomo
Vayehi devar haelohim el-shemaya ish-haelohim lemor
Emor el-rechavam ben-shelomo melech yehuda veel-kal-bet yehuda uvinyamin veyeter haam lemor
Ko amar Adonai lo-taalu velo-tillachamun im-achechem bene-yisrael shuvu ish leveto ki meitti nihya haddavar hazze vayyishmeu et-devar Adonai vayyashuvu lalechet kidvar Adonai
Vayyiven yaravam et-shechem behar efrayim vayyeshev bah vayyetze mishsham vayyiven et-penuel
Vayyomer yaravam belibbo atta tashuv hammamlacha levet david
Im-yaale haam hazze laasot zevachim bevet-Adonai birushalam veshav lev haam hazze el-adonehem el-rechavam melech yehuda vaharaguni veshavu el-rechavam melech-yehuda
Vayyivaatz hammelech vayyaas shene egle zahav vayyomer alehem rav-lachem mealot yerushalam hinne elohecha yisrael asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim
Vayyasem et-haechad bevet-el veet-haechad natan bedan
Vayehi haddavar hazze lechattat vayyelchu haam lifne haechad ad-dan
Vayyaas et-bet bamot vayyaas kohanim miktzot haam asher lo-hau mibbene levi

Vayyaas yaravam chag bachodesh hashshemini bachamishsha-asar yom lachodesh kechag asher bihuda vayyaal al-hammizbeach ken asa bevet-el lezabbeach laagalim asher-asa veheemid bevet el et-kohane habbamot asher asa
Vayyaal al-hammizbeach asher-asa bevet-el bachamishsha asar yom bachodesh hashshemini bachodesh asher-bada millibbo vayyaas chag livne yisrael vayyaal al-hammizbeach lehaktir
Vehinne ish elohim ba mihuda bidvar Adonai el-bet-el veyaravam omed al-hammizbeach lehaktir

Vayyikra al-hammizbeach bidvar Adonai vayyomer mizbeach mizbeach ko amar Adonai hinne-ven nolad levet-david yoshiyyahu shemo vezavach alecha et-kohane habbamot hammaktirim alecha veatzmot adam yisrefu alecha
Venatan bayyom hahu mofet lemor ze hammofet asher dibber Adonai hinne hammizbeach nikra venishpach haddeshen asher-alav

Vayehi chishmoa hammelech et-devar ish-haelohim asher kara al-hammizbeach bevet-el vayyishlach yaravam et-yado meal hammizbeach lemor tifsuhu vattivash yado asher shalach alav velo yachol lahashivah elav
Vehammizbeach nikra vayyishshafech haddeshen min-hammizbeach kammofet asher natan ish haelohim bidvar Adonai
Vayyaan hammelech vayyomer el-ish haelohim chal-na et-pene Adonai elohecha vehitpallel baadi vetashov yadi ela vayechal ish-haelohim et-pene Adonai vattashav yad-hammelech elav vattehi kevarishona
Vayedabber hammelech el-ish haelohim boa-itti habbayeta usada veettena lecha mattat
Vayyomer ish-haelohim el-hammelech im-titten-li et-chatzi vetecha lo avo immach velo-ochal lechem velo eshte-mayim bammakom hazze
Ki-chen tziva oti bidvar Adonai lemor lo-tochal lechem velo tishte-mayim velo tashuv badderech asher halachta
Vayyelech bederech acher velo-shav badderech asher ba vah el-bet-el

Achazyahu ven-achav malach al-yisrael beshomron bishnat sheva esre lihoshafat melech yehuda vayyimloch al-yisrael shenatayim
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai vayyelech bederech aviv uvderech immo uvderech yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael
Vayyaavod et-habbaal vayyishtachave lo vayyaches et-Adonai elohe yisrael kechol asher-asa aviv
